title: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: “O Sanjaya, what did my people and the Pāṇḍavas do,…
sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच\nधर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।\nमामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय
transliteration: dhṛitarāśhtra uvācha |\ndharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ |\nmāmakāḥ pāṇḍavāśhchaiva kimakurvata sañjaya |
meaning: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: “O Sanjaya, what did my people and the Pāṇḍavas do, gathered together on the holy field of Kurukshetra, eager for battle?”

title: Sanjaya said: King Duryodhana, upon seeing the Pandava army in battle…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच\nदृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा।\nआचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\ndṛiṣhṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā |\nāchāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vachanamabravīt |
meaning: Sanjaya said: King Duryodhana, upon seeing the Pandava army in battle array, approached his teacher Drona and said these words.

title: Behold, O teacher, this mighty army of the Pandavas, arrayed by the s…
sanskrit: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्।\nव्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता
transliteration: paśhyaitāṁ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām āchārya mahatīṁ chamūm |\nvyūḍhāṁ drupada-putreṇa tava śhiṣhyeṇa dhīmatā |
meaning: Behold, O teacher, this mighty army of the Pandavas, arrayed by the son of Drupada, your intelligent disciple.

title: There (in that army) are heroes, great bowmen, such as Bhima and Arju…
sanskrit: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि।\nयुयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः
transliteration: atra śhūrā maheṣhvāsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi |\nyuyudhāno virāṭaśhcha drupadaśhcha mahā-rathaḥ |
meaning: There (in that army) are heroes, great bowmen, such as Bhima and Arjuna; Yuyudhana, Virata, and Drupada, a mighty warrior;

title: Dhrstaketu, Cekitana, the valiant king of Kasi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja,…
sanskrit: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्।\nपुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः
transliteration: dhṛiṣhṭaketuśhchekitānaḥ kāśhirājaśhcha vīryavān |\npurujit kuntibhojaśhcha śhaibyaśhcha nara-puṅgavaḥ |\nyudhāmanyuśhcha vikrānta uttamaujāśhcha vīryavān |
meaning: Dhrstaketu, Cekitana, the valiant king of Kasi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Saibya, the best among men;

title: Yudhamanyu, the valiant one, and Uttamaujas, the strong one; and also…
sanskrit: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्।\nसौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः
transliteration: saubhadro draupadeyāśhcha sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ |
meaning: Yudhamanyu, the valiant one, and Uttamaujas, the strong one; and also the son of Subhadra, as well as the sons of Draupadi, all mighty warriors.

title: Know, O best of Brahmanas, those who are important on our side—those…
sanskrit: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम।\nनायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते
transliteration: asmākaṁ tu viśhiṣhṭā ye tānnibodha dwijottama |\nnāyakā mama sainyasya sanjñārthaṁ tānbravīmi te |
meaning: Know, O best of Brahmanas, those who are important on our side—those who are the commanders of my army. I shall name them to refresh your memory.

title: Yourself, Bhisma, Karna, the victorious Krpa, Asvatthama, Vikarna, an…
sanskrit: भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः।\nअश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च
transliteration: bhavānbhīṣhmaśhcha karṇaśhcha kṛipaśhcha samitiñjayaḥ |\naśhvatthāmā vikarṇaśhcha saumadattis tathaiva cha |
meaning: Yourself, Bhisma, Karna, the victorious Krpa, Asvatthama, Vikarna, and Jayadratha, the son of Somadatta;

title: And there are many other heroes who are determined to give up their l…
sanskrit: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः।\nनानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः
transliteration: anye cha bahavaḥ śhūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ |\nnānā-śhastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśhāradāḥ |
meaning: And there are many other heroes who are determined to give up their lives for my sake. They are all experts in using manifold missiles and dexterous in battle.

title: Our force is inadequate, guarded by Bhisma, while their force is adeq…
sanskrit: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्।\nपर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्
transliteration: aparyāptaṁ tadasmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣhmābhirakṣhitam |\nparyāptaṁ tvidameteṣhāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣhitam |
meaning: Our force is inadequate, guarded by Bhisma, while their force is adequate, guarded by Bhima.

title: Therefore, all of you, taking your places firmly in your respective d…
sanskrit: अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः।\nभीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि
transliteration: ayaneṣhu cha sarveṣhu yathā-bhāgamavasthitāḥ |\nbhīṣhmamevābhirakṣhantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi |
meaning: Therefore, all of you, taking your places firmly in your respective divisions, should guard Bhisma at all costs.

title: Then the valiant grandsire Bhisma, the senior-most of the Kuru clan,…
sanskrit: तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः।\nसिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्
transliteration: tasya sañjanayan harṣhaṁ kuru-vṛiddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ |\nsiṁha-nādaṁ vinadyochchaiḥ śhaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān |
meaning: Then the valiant grandsire Bhisma, the senior-most of the Kuru clan, roared like a lion and blew his conch with the intention of cheering up Duryodhana.

title: Then suddenly conchs, kettle drums, trumpets, tabors, and blow horns…
sanskrit: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः।\nसहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्
transliteration: tataḥ śhaṅkhāśhcha bheryaśhcha paṇavānaka-gomukhāḥ |\nsahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śhabdastumulo ’bhavat |
meaning: Then suddenly conchs, kettle drums, trumpets, tabors, and blow horns blared forth, and the sound was terrific.

title: Then Sri Krishna and Arjuna, stationed in their great chariot yoked w…
sanskrit: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ।\nमाधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः
transliteration: tataḥ śhvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau |\nmādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaśhchaiva divyau śhaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ |
meaning: Then Sri Krishna and Arjuna, stationed in their great chariot yoked with white horses, blew their divine conchs.

title: Sri Krishna blew his conch, Pancajanya, Arjuna his Devadatta, and Bhi…
sanskrit: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः।\nपौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः
transliteration: pāñchajanyaṁ hṛiṣhīkeśho devadattaṁ dhanañjayaḥ |\npauṇḍraṁ dadhmau mahā-śhaṅkhaṁ bhīma-karmā vṛikodaraḥ |
meaning: Sri Krishna blew his conch, Pancajanya, Arjuna his Devadatta, and Bhima of terrible deeds blew his great conch, Paundra.

title: King Yudhisthira, the son of Kunti, blew his conch, Anantavijaya, and…
sanskrit: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।\nनकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ
transliteration: anantavijayaṁ rājā kuntī-putro yudhiṣhṭhiraḥ |\nnakulaḥ sahadevaśhcha sughoṣha-maṇipuṣhpakau |
meaning: King Yudhisthira, the son of Kunti, blew his conch, Anantavijaya, and Nakula and Sahadeva blew their conchs, Sughosa and Manipuspaka.

title: And the King of Kasi, the supreme bowman, Sikandi the mighty warrior,…
sanskrit: काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः।\nधृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः
transliteration: kāśhyaśhcha parameṣhvāsaḥ śhikhaṇḍī cha mahā-rathaḥ |\ndhṛiṣhṭadyumno virāṭaśhcha sātyakiśh chāparājitaḥ |
meaning: And the King of Kasi, the supreme bowman, Sikandi the mighty warrior, Dhrstadyumna, and Virata; and Satyaki, the invincible;

title: Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, as well as the strong-armed son of…
sanskrit: द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते।\nसौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्
transliteration: drupado draupadeyāśhcha sarvaśhaḥ pṛithivī-pate |\nsaubhadraśhcha mahā-bāhuḥ śhaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛithak pṛithak |
meaning: Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, as well as the strong-armed son of Subhadra—all, O King, blew their respective conchs again and again.

title: And that tumultuous uproar, reverberating through heaven and earth, r…
sanskrit: स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्।\nनभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्
transliteration: sa ghoṣho dhārtarāṣhṭrāṇāṁ hṛidayāni vyadārayat |\nnabhaśhcha pṛithivīṁ chaiva tumulo nunādayan |
meaning: And that tumultuous uproar, reverberating through heaven and earth, rent the hearts of Dhrtarastra's sons.

title: Then Arjuna, whose banner crest was Hanuman, on beholding the sons of…
sanskrit: अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः।\nप्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः
transliteration: atha vyavasthitān dṛiṣhṭvā dhārtarāṣhṭrān kapi-dhwajaḥ |\npravṛitte śhastra-sampāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ |\nhṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ tadā vākyam idam āha mahī-pate |
meaning: Then Arjuna, whose banner crest was Hanuman, on beholding the sons of Dhrtarastra arrayed, took up his bow, while missiles were beginning to fly.

title: And he spoke, O Lord of the Earth, these words to Sri Krishna: Arjuna…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nहृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।\nसेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nsenayor ubhayor madhye rathaṁ sthāpaya me ’chyuta |
meaning: And he spoke, O Lord of the Earth, these words to Sri Krishna: Arjuna said, “Draw up my chariot, O Krishna, between the two armies.

title: So that I may have a good look at those who are standing, eager to fi…
sanskrit: यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्।\nकैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे
transliteration: yāvadetān nirīkṣhe ’haṁ yoddhu-kāmān avasthitān |\nkairmayā saha yoddhavyam asmin raṇa-samudyame |
meaning: So that I may have a good look at those who are standing, eager to fight, and know with whom I must fight in this enterprise of war.

title: I wish to see those gathered here ready to fight in this battle in or…
sanskrit: योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः।\nधार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः
transliteration: yotsyamānān avekṣhe ’haṁ ya ete ’tra samāgatāḥ |\ndhārtarāṣhṭrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-chikīrṣhavaḥ |
meaning: I wish to see those gathered here ready to fight in this battle in order to please the evil-minded son of Dhrtarashtra.

title: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Sri Krishna drew up the best…
sanskrit: संजय उवाच\nएवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत।\nसेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\nevam ukto hṛiṣhīkeśho guḍākeśhena bhārata |\nsenayor ubhayor madhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam |
meaning: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Sri Krishna drew up the best of chariots between the two armies, in full view of Bhisma, Drona, and all the other kings, O Dhrtarastra. He then said, "O Arjuna, behold these assembled Kauravas."

title: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Sri Krishna drew up the best…
sanskrit: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्।\nउवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति
transliteration: bhīṣhma-droṇa-pramukhataḥ sarveṣhāṁ cha mahī-kṣhitām |\nuvācha pārtha paśhyaitān samavetān kurūn iti |
meaning: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Sri Krishna drew up the best of chariots between the two armies, in full view of Bhisma, Drona, and all the other kings, O Dhrtarastra. He then said, "O Arjuna, behold these assembled Kauravas."

title: Then, as Arjuna looked on, he saw standing there fathers, grandfather…
sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्।\nआचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा
transliteration: tatrāpaśhyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝīn atha pitāmahān |\nāchāryān mātulān bhrātṝīn putrān pautrān sakhīṁs tathā |\nśhvaśhurān suhṛidaśh chaiva senayor ubhayor api |
meaning: Then, as Arjuna looked on, he saw standing there fathers, grandfathers, teachers, uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, and comrades.

title: Fathers-in-law and dear friends in both armies, when Arjuna saw all t…
sanskrit: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि।\nतान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्
transliteration: tān samīkṣhya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān |\nkṛipayā parayāviṣhṭo viṣhīdann idam abravīt |
meaning: Fathers-in-law and dear friends in both armies, when Arjuna saw all these kinsmen arrayed,

title: He was filled with deep compassion and said these words in despair:
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nकृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्।\nदृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\ndṛiṣhṭvemaṁ sva-janaṁ kṛiṣhṇa yuyutsuṁ samupasthitam |
meaning: He was filled with deep compassion and said these words in despair:

title: My limbs have weakened, my mouth has become parched, my body is tremb…
sanskrit: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।\nवेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते
transliteration: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati |\nvepathuśh cha śharīre me roma-harṣhaśh cha jāyate |
meaning: My limbs have weakened, my mouth has become parched, my body is trembling, and my hairs are standing on end.

title: The bow Gandiva slips from my hand and my skin is burning
sanskrit: गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते।\nन च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः
transliteration: gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak chaiva paridahyate |\nna cha śhaknomy avasthātuṁ bhramatīva cha me manaḥ |
meaning: The bow Gandiva slips from my hand and my skin is burning. I can no longer stand. My mind seems to be reeling.

title: I see, Kṛṣṇa, inauspicious omens
sanskrit: निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव।\nन च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे
transliteration: nimittāni cha paśhyāmi viparītāni keśhava |\nna cha śhreyo ’nupaśhyāmi hatvā sva-janam āhave |
meaning: I see, Kṛṣṇa, inauspicious omens. I foresee no good in slaying my kinsmen in battle.

title: I desire no victory, nor empire, nor pleasures
sanskrit: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च।\nकिं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा
transliteration: na kāṅkṣhe vijayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa na cha rājyaṁ sukhāni cha |\nkiṁ no rājyena govinda kiṁ bhogair jīvitena vā |
meaning: I desire no victory, nor empire, nor pleasures. What have we to do with empire, O Krishna, or enjoyment, or even life?

title: Those for whose sake we desire empire, enjoyment, and pleasures, stan…
sanskrit: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।\nत इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च
transliteration: yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha |\nta ime ’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni cha |
meaning: Those for whose sake we desire empire, enjoyment, and pleasures, stand here in war, renouncing life and wealth.

title: all these are to be regarded as one's own self
sanskrit: आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः।\nमातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा
transliteration: āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ |\nmātulāḥ śhvaśhurāḥ pautrāḥ śhyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā |
meaning: all these are to be regarded as one's own self. Teachers, fathers, sons, grandfathers, uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other kinsmen—all these are to be regarded as one's own self.

title: I would not slay them, even if they might slay me, for the sovereignt…
sanskrit: एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन।\nअपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते
transliteration: etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana |\napi trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahī-kṛite |
meaning: I would not slay them, even if they might slay me, for the sovereignty of the three worlds—how much less for this earth, O Krsna?

title: If we were to kill the sons of Dhrtarastra, what joy would be ours, O…
sanskrit: निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।\nपापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः
transliteration: nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana |\npāpam evāśhrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ |
meaning: If we were to kill the sons of Dhrtarastra, what joy would be ours, O Krsna? Sin alone would accrue to us if we killed these murderous felons.

title: Therefore, it is not befitting for us to slay our kin, the sons of Dh…
sanskrit: तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्।\nस्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव
transliteration: tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān |\nsva-janaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava |
meaning: Therefore, it is not befitting for us to slay our kin, the sons of Dhrtarastra. For if we kill our kinsmen, O Krsna, how can we be happy?

title: Though these people, whose minds are overpowered by greed, see no evi…
sanskrit: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।\nकुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्
transliteration: yady apy ete na paśhyanti lobhopahata-chetasaḥ |\nkula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ mitra-drohe cha pātakam |
meaning: Though these people, whose minds are overpowered by greed, see no evil in the destruction of a clan and no sin in treachery to friends,

title: Why should we not learn to shun this crime—we who see the evil of rui…
sanskrit: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।\nकुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन
transliteration: kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum |\nkula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ prapaśhyadbhir janārdana |
meaning: Why should we not learn to shun this crime—we who see the evil of ruining a clan, O Krishna?

title: With the ruin of a clan, its ancient traditions perish, and when trad…
sanskrit: कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः।\nधर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत
transliteration: kula-kṣhaye praṇaśhyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ |\ndharme naṣhṭe kulaṁ kṛitsnam adharmo ’bhibhavaty uta |
meaning: With the ruin of a clan, its ancient traditions perish, and when traditions perish, lawlessness overtakes the whole clan.

title: When lawlessness prevails, O Krsna, the women of the clan become corr…
sanskrit: अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः।\nस्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः
transliteration: adharmābhibhavāt kṛiṣhṇa praduṣhyanti kula-striyaḥ |\nstrīṣhu duṣhṭāsu vārṣhṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ |
meaning: When lawlessness prevails, O Krsna, the women of the clan become corrupted; when women become corrupted, there arises an intermixing of classes.

title: This mixing of classes leads to hell for the clan itself and its dest…
sanskrit: सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च।\nपतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः
transliteration: saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṁ kulasya cha |\npatanti pitaro hy eṣhāṁ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ |
meaning: This mixing of classes leads to hell for the clan itself and its destroyers; for the spirits of their ancestors fall degraded, deprived of the ritual offerings of food and water.

title: By the sins of the clan-destroyers who bring about intermixing of cla…
sanskrit: दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः।\nउत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः
transliteration: doṣhair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṁ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ |\nutsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāśh cha śhāśhvatāḥ |
meaning: By the sins of the clan-destroyers who bring about intermixing of classes, the ancient traditions of the clans and classes are destroyed.

title: For those whose clan laws are destroyed, dwelling in hell is ordained…
sanskrit: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन।\nनरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम
transliteration: utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṁ manuṣhyāṇāṁ janārdana |\nnarake ‘niyataṁ vāso bhavatītyanuśhuśhruma |
meaning: For those whose clan laws are destroyed, dwelling in hell is ordained, O Krishna; thus, we have heard.

title: Alas
sanskrit: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।\nयद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः
transliteration: aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam |\nyad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṁ sva-janam udyatāḥ |
meaning: Alas! We have resolved to commit a great sin, for we are ready to slay our kin out of desire for sovereignty and enjoyment.

title: If the well-armed sons of Dhrtarastra should slay me in battle, unres…
sanskrit: यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः।\nधार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्
transliteration: yadi mām apratīkāram aśhastraṁ śhastra-pāṇayaḥ |\ndhārtarāṣhṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣhemataraṁ bhavet |
meaning: If the well-armed sons of Dhrtarastra should slay me in battle, unresisting and unarmed, that would be better for me.

title: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus on the battlefield, Arjuna threw asi…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच\nएवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।\nविसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\nevam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśhat |\nvisṛijya sa-śharaṁ chāpaṁ śhoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ |
meaning: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus on the battlefield, Arjuna threw aside his bow and arrows and sat down on the chariot seat, his heart overwhelmed with grief.

title: Sanjaya said: To him, who was overcome with pity, whose eyes were wet…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच\nतं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्।\nविषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\ntaṁ tathā kṛipayāviṣhṭamaśhru pūrṇākulekṣhaṇam |\nviṣhīdantamidaṁ vākyam uvācha madhusūdanaḥ |
meaning: Sanjaya said: To him, who was overcome with pity, whose eyes were wet with tears, who was sorrow-stricken and bore a bewildered look, Sri Krishna spoke as follows:

title: The Lord said, "Whence comes this despondency upon you, O Arjuna, in…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nकुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्।\nअनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nkutastvā kaśhmalamidaṁ viṣhame samupasthitam |\nanārya-juṣhṭamaswargyam akīrti-karam arjuna |
meaning: The Lord said, "Whence comes this despondency upon you, O Arjuna, in this crisis? It is unfitting for a noble person; it is disgraceful and it obstructs one's attainment of heaven."

title: Do not yield to unmanliness, O Arjuna, it does not befit you
sanskrit: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।\nक्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप
transliteration: klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate |\nkṣhudraṁ hṛidaya-daurbalyaṁ tyaktvottiṣhṭha parantapa |
meaning: Do not yield to unmanliness, O Arjuna, it does not befit you. Shake off this base faint-heartedness and arise, O conqueror of foes!

title: Arjuna said, "O slayer of foes, how can I aim arrows in battle agains…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nकथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन।\nइषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nkathaṁ bhīṣhmam ahaṁ sankhye droṇaṁ cha madhusūdana |\niṣhubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvari-sūdana |
meaning: Arjuna said, "O slayer of foes, how can I aim arrows in battle against Bhisma and Drona, who are worthy of reverence?"

title: It is better even to live on a beggar's fare in this world than to sl…
sanskrit:
गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्
श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके।
हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव
भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्
transliteration:
gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān |
śhreyo bhoktuṁ bhaikṣhyamapīha loke |
hatvārtha-kāmāṁstu gurūnihaiva |
bhuñjīya bhogān rudhira-pradigdhān |
meaning: It is better even to live on a beggar's fare in this world than to slay these most venerable teachers. If I were to slay my teachers, though they may be degraded by desire for wealth, I would only be enjoying blood-stained pleasures here.

title: We do not know which of the two is better for us: whether our vanquis…
sanskrit:
न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो
यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः।
यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम
स्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः
transliteration:
na chaitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo |
yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ |
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣhāmas |
te ’vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣhṭrāḥ |
meaning: We do not know which of the two is better for us: whether our vanquishing them or their vanquishing us. The very sons of Dhrtarastra, whom, if we were to slay, we would not wish to live, even they are standing in array against us.

title: With my heart stricken by the fault of weak compassion, my mind perpl…
sanskrit:
कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः
पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः।
यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्िचतं ब्रूहि तन्मे
शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्
transliteration:
kārpaṇya-doṣhopahata-svabhāvaḥ |
pṛichchhāmi tvāṁ dharma-sammūḍha-chetāḥ |
yach-chhreyaḥ syānniśhchitaṁ brūhi tanme |
śhiṣhyaste ’haṁ śhādhi māṁ tvāṁ prapannam |
meaning: With my heart stricken by the fault of weak compassion, my mind perplexed about my duty, I implore you to tell me for certain what is good for me. I am your disciple; teach me, who have taken refuge in you.

title: Even if I were to win unchallenged sovereignty of a prosperous earth…
sanskrit:
न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्या
द्यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम्।
अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धम्
राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम्
transliteration:
na hi prapaśhyāmi mamāpanudyād |
yach-chhokam uchchhoṣhaṇam-indriyāṇām |
avāpya bhūmāv-asapatnamṛiddhaṁ |
rājyaṁ surāṇāmapi chādhipatyam |
meaning: Even if I were to win unchallenged sovereignty of a prosperous earth or even lordship over the Devas, I do not feel that it would dispel the grief that withers up my senses.

title: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Sri Krsna, Arjuna, the conqueror…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच\nएवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप।\nन योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\nevam-uktvā hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ guḍākeśhaḥ parantapa |\nna yotsya iti govindam uktvā tūṣhṇīṁ babhūva ha |
meaning: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Sri Krsna, Arjuna, the conqueror of sleep and the scorcher of foes, said, "I will not fight," and became silent.

title: O King, to him who was thus sorrowing between the two armies, Sri Kri…
sanskrit: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत।\nसेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः
transliteration: tam-uvācha hṛiṣhīkeśhaḥ prahasanniva bhārata |\nsenayorubhayor-madhye viṣhīdantam-idaṁ vachaḥ |
meaning: O King, to him who was thus sorrowing between the two armies, Sri Krishna spoke the following words, as if smiling (by way of ridicule).

title: The Lord said, "You grieve for those who should not be grieved for; y…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nअशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे।\nगतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\naśhochyān-anvaśhochas-tvaṁ prajñā-vādānśh cha bhāṣhase |\ngatāsūn-agatāsūnśh-cha nānuśhochanti paṇḍitāḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "You grieve for those who should not be grieved for; yet you speak words of wisdom. The wise grieve neither for the dead nor for the living."

title: There never was a time when I did not exist, nor you, nor any of thes…
sanskrit: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः।\nन चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम्
transliteration: na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ |\nna chaiva na bhaviṣhyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param |
meaning: There never was a time when I did not exist, nor you, nor any of these kings. Nor will there be any time in the future when all of us shall cease to exist.

title: Just as the self associated with a body passes through childhood, you…
sanskrit: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा।\nतथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति
transliteration: dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā |\ntathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati |
meaning: Just as the self associated with a body passes through childhood, youth, and old age, so too, at death, it passes into another body. A wise man is not deluded by that.

title: The contact of the senses with their objects, O Arjuna, gives rise to…
sanskrit: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।\nआगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत
transliteration: mātrā-sparśhās tu kaunteya śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ |\nāgamāpāyino ’nityās tans-titikṣhasva bhārata |
meaning: The contact of the senses with their objects, O Arjuna, gives rise to feelings of cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They come and go, never lasting long. Endure them, O Arjuna.

title: For, he whom these do not affect, O chief of men, and to whom pain an…
sanskrit: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ।\nसमदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते
transliteration: yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣhaṁ puruṣharṣhabha |\nsama-duḥkha-sukhaṁ dhīraṁ so ’mṛitatvāya kalpate |
meaning: For, he whom these do not affect, O chief of men, and to whom pain and pleasure are equal - that steadfast man alone is worthy of immortality.

title: The unreal never comes into being, the real never ceases to be
sanskrit: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।\nउभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
transliteration: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ |\nubhayorapi dṛiṣhṭo ’nta stvanayos tattva-darśhibhiḥ |
meaning: The unreal never comes into being, the real never ceases to be. The truth about these two is seen by the seers.

title: Know that to be indestructible by which all this is pervaded
sanskrit: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।\nविनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित् कर्तुमर्हति
transliteration: avināśhi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idaṁ tatam |\nvināśham avyayasyāsya na kaśhchit kartum arhati |
meaning: Know that to be indestructible by which all this is pervaded. No one can cause the destruction of this immutable.

title: These bodies of the Jiva (the embodied self) are said to have an end,…
sanskrit: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः।\nअनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत
transliteration: antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śharīriṇaḥ |\nanāśhino ’prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata |
meaning: These bodies of the Jiva (the embodied self) are said to have an end, while the Jiva itself is eternal, indestructible, and incomprehensible. Therefore, fight, O Bharata (Arjuna).

title: He who considers It (the self) to be the slayer, and he who thinks of…
sanskrit: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्।\nउभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते
transliteration: ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaśh chainaṁ manyate hatam |\nubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṁ hanti na hanyate |
meaning: He who considers It (the self) to be the slayer, and he who thinks of It as slain—both are ignorant. For, the self neither slays nor is being slain.

title: It is never born; it never dies; having come into existence once, it…
sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि
न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो
न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे
transliteration:
na jāyate mriyate vā kadāchin |
nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ |
ajo nityaḥ śhāśhvato ’yaṁ purāṇo |
na hanyate hanyamāne śharīre |
meaning: It is never born; it never dies; having come into existence once, it never ceases to exist. Unborn, eternal, perpetual, and primordial, it is not destroyed when the body is destroyed.

title: He who knows this self to be indestructible, unborn, unchanging, and…
sanskrit: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्।\nकथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्
transliteration: vedāvināśhinaṁ nityaṁ ya enam ajam avyayam |\nkathaṁ sa puruṣhaḥ pārtha kaṁ ghātayati hanti kam |
meaning: He who knows this self to be indestructible, unborn, unchanging, and thus eternal—how, O Arjuna, does he cause anyone to be killed, and whom does he kill?

title: As a man casts off worn-out garments and puts on new ones, so does th…
sanskrit:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय
नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा
न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही
transliteration:
vāsānsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya |
navāni gṛihṇāti naro ’parāṇi |
tathā śharīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānya |
nyāni sanyāti navāni dehī |
meaning: As a man casts off worn-out garments and puts on new ones, so does the embodied self cast off its worn-out bodies and enter into new ones.

title: Weapons cannot cleave It, fire cannot burn It, waters cannot wet It,…
sanskrit: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।\nन चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः
transliteration: nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ |\nna chainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śhoṣhayati mārutaḥ |
meaning: Weapons cannot cleave It, fire cannot burn It, waters cannot wet It, and wind cannot dry It.

title: It cannot be cleaved; It cannot be burned; It cannot be wetted, and I…
sanskrit: अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च।\nनित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः
transliteration: achchhedyo ’yam adāhyo ’yam akledyo ’śhoṣhya eva cha |\nnityaḥ sarva-gataḥ sthāṇur achalo ’yaṁ sanātanaḥ |
meaning: It cannot be cleaved; It cannot be burned; It cannot be wetted, and It cannot be dried; It is eternal, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, and primordial.

title: This (self) is said to be unmanifest, inconceivable, and unchanging
sanskrit: अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते।\nतस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: avyakto ’yam achintyo ’yam avikāryo ’yam uchyate |\ntasmādevaṁ viditvainaṁ nānuśhochitum arhasi |
meaning: This (self) is said to be unmanifest, inconceivable, and unchanging. Therefore, knowing it thus, it does not befit you to grieve.

title: Or, if you consider this self as constantly being born and constantly…
sanskrit: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।\nतथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam |\ntathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi |
meaning: Or, if you consider this self as constantly being born and constantly dying, O mighty-armed one, it still does not become you to feel grief.

title: For, death is certain for the born, and rebirth is certain for the de…
sanskrit: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।\nतस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha |\ntasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi |
meaning: For, death is certain for the born, and rebirth is certain for the dead; therefore, you should not grieve for what is inevitable.

title: O Arjuna, beings have an unknown beginning, a known middle, and an un…
sanskrit: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत।\nअव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना
transliteration: avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata |\navyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā |
meaning: O Arjuna, beings have an unknown beginning, a known middle, and an unknown end. What is there to grieve about in all this?

title: One regards This (self) as a wonder; another speaks of It as a wonder…
sanskrit:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन
माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।
आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति
श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्
transliteration:
āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan |
āśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ |
āśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti |
śhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit |
meaning: One regards This (self) as a wonder; another speaks of It as a wonder; yet another hears of It as a wonder; and even after hearing of It, one does not know It.

title: The self in the body, O Arjuna, is eternal and indestructible
sanskrit: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।\nतस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata |\ntasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi |
meaning: The self in the body, O Arjuna, is eternal and indestructible. This is the case for all selves in all bodies. Therefore, it is not fitting for you to feel grief for any being.

title: Further, considering also your own duty, it does not befit you to waver
sanskrit: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि।\nधर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते
transliteration: swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi |\ndharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate |
meaning: Further, considering also your own duty, it does not befit you to waver. For, to a Kshatriya, there is no greater good than a righteous war.

title: Happy are the Ksatriyas, O Arjuna, to whom such a war comes of its ow…
sanskrit: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।\nसुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्
transliteration: yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam |\nsukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham |
meaning: Happy are the Ksatriyas, O Arjuna, to whom such a war comes of its own accord; it opens the gates to heaven.

title: But if you do not fight this righteous war, you will be turning away…
sanskrit: अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।\nततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi |\ntataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi |
meaning: But if you do not fight this righteous war, you will be turning away from your duty and honor, and will incur sin.

title: Further, people will speak ill of you for all time, and for one accus…
sanskrit: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।\nसंभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते
transliteration:
akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni |
kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām |
sambhāvitasya chākīrtir |
maraṇād atirichyate |
meaning: Further, people will speak ill of you for all time, and for one accustomed to being honored, dishonor is worse than death.

title: The great warriors will think that you have fled from battle out of fear
sanskrit: भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।\nयेषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्
transliteration: bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ |\nyeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam |
meaning: The great warriors will think that you have fled from battle out of fear. Those who held you in high esteem will now speak of you disparagingly.

title: Your enemies, slandering your prowess, will use words that should nev…
sanskrit: अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।\nनिन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्
transliteration: avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ |\nnindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim |
meaning: Your enemies, slandering your prowess, will use words that should never be uttered. What could be more painful than that?

title: If slain, you will win heaven; or if victorious, you will enjoy the e…
sanskrit: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।\nतस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः
transliteration: hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm |\ntasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ |
meaning: If slain, you will win heaven; or if victorious, you will enjoy the earth. Therefore, arise, O Arjuna, resolved to fight.

title: Holding pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat as equal…
sanskrit: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ।\nततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau |\ntato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi |
meaning: Holding pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat as equal, gird yourself up for the battle. Thus, you shall not incur any sin.

title: This Buddhi concerning the Self (Sankhya) has been imparted to you
sanskrit: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।\nबुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि
transliteration:
eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye |
buddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu |
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha |
karma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi |
meaning: This Buddhi concerning the Self (Sankhya) has been imparted to you. Now listen to this with regard to Yoga, by following which you will get rid of the bondage of Karma.

title: Here, there is no loss of effort, nor any accrual of evil
sanskrit: नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।\nस्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्
transliteration: nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate |\nsvalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt |
meaning: Here, there is no loss of effort, nor any accrual of evil. Even a little of this Dharma (called Karma Yoga) protects one from the great fear.

title: In this (Karma Yoga), O Arjuna, the resolute mind is single-pointed;…
sanskrit: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।\nबहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्
transliteration: vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana |\nbahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām |
meaning: In this (Karma Yoga), O Arjuna, the resolute mind is single-pointed; the minds of the irresolute are multi-branched and endless.

title: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say,…
sanskrit: यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।\nवेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः
transliteration:
yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ |
veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ |
kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām |
kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati |
meaning: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say, "There is nothing else." They are full only of worldly desires and they hanker for heaven. They speak flowery words that offer mirth as the fruit of work. They look upon the Vedas as consisting entirely of varied rites for the attainment of pleasure and power. Those who cling so to pleasure and power are attracted by that speech (offering heavenly rewards) and are unable to develop the resolute will of a concentrated mind.

title: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say,…
sanskrit: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्।\nक्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति
transliteration:
kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā |
janma-karma-phala-pradām |
kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ |
bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati |
meaning: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say, "There is nothing else." They are full only of worldly desires and they yearn for heaven. They speak flowery words that offer mirth as the fruit of work. They view the Vedas as consisting entirely of varied rites for the attainment of pleasure and power. Those who cling so to pleasure and power are attracted by that speech (offering heavenly rewards) and are unable to develop the resolute will of a focused mind.

title: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say,…
sanskrit: भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्।\nव्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते
transliteration: bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām |\nvyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate |
meaning: - O Partha, the unwise, who rejoice in the letter of the Vedas, say, "There is nothing else." They are full only of worldly desires and they hanker for heaven. They speak flowery words that offer mirth as the fruit of work. They look upon the Vedas as consisting entirely of varied rites for the attainment of pleasure and power. Those who cling so to pleasure and power are attracted by that speech (offering heavenly rewards) and are unable to develop the resolute will of a concentrated mind.

title: The Vedas have the three Gunas as their sphere, O Arjuna
sanskrit: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन।\nनिर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्
transliteration: trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna |\nnirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān |
meaning: The Vedas have the three Gunas as their sphere, O Arjuna. You must be free from the three Gunas and be free from the pairs of opposites. Abide in pure Sattva; never care to acquire things and to protect what has been acquired, but be established in the Self.

title: What use does a thirsty person have for a water reservoir when all si…
sanskrit: यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके।\nतावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः
transliteration: yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake |\ntāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ |
meaning: What use does a thirsty person have for a water reservoir when all sides of it are flooded—that is the only use of all the Vedas for a Brahmana who knows.

title: You have the right to work alone, but not to the fruits of it
sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।\nमा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि
transliteration: karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana |\nmā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi |
meaning: You have the right to work alone, but not to the fruits of it. Do not be driven by the results of your work, nor have attachment to inaction.

title: Abandoning attachment and established in Yoga, perform works, viewing…
sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।\nसिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
transliteration: yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya |\nsiddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate |
meaning: Abandoning attachment and established in Yoga, perform works, viewing success and failure with an even mind. Evenness of mind is said to be Yoga.

title: Action done with attachment, O Arjuna, is far inferior to action done…
sanskrit: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय।\nबुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः
transliteration: dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya |\nbuddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ |
meaning: Action done with attachment, O Arjuna, is far inferior to action done with evenness of mind. Seek refuge in evenness of mind; those who act with a motive for results are miserable.

title: A person with an evenness of mind discards both good and evil here an…
sanskrit: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।\nतस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
transliteration: buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite |\ntasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam |
meaning: A person with an evenness of mind discards both good and evil here and now. Therefore, strive for Yoga; for Yoga is skill in action.

title: The wise, who possess evenness of mind, relinquish the fruits born of…
sanskrit: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।\nजन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्
transliteration: karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ |\njanma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam |
meaning: The wise, who possess evenness of mind, relinquish the fruits born of action, and are freed from the bondage of birth, going to the region beyond all ills.

title: When your intellect has passed beyond the tangle of delusion, you wil…
sanskrit: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति।\nतदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च
transliteration: yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati |\ntadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha |
meaning: When your intellect has passed beyond the tangle of delusion, you will yourself feel disgusted with what you have heard and what you will hear.

title: When your intellect, having been well enlightened by hearing from Me…
sanskrit: श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।\nसमाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā |\nsamādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi |
meaning: When your intellect, having been well enlightened by hearing from Me and firmly placed, stands unshaken in a concentrated mind, then you will attain the vision of the Self.

title: Arjuna said, "What is the mode of speech of one who is of firm wisdom…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nस्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव।\nस्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nsthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava |\nsthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim |
meaning: Arjuna said, "What is the mode of speech of one who is of firm wisdom, established in the control of the mind? What does a man of firm wisdom speak, O Krsna? How does he sit? How does he move?"

title: The Lord said, "When a man renounces all the desires of the mind and…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nप्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।\nआत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nprajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān |\nātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate |
meaning: The Lord said, "When a man renounces all the desires of the mind and is content with himself, then he is said to possess firm wisdom."

title: He whose mind is not perturbed by pain, who has no longing for pleasu…
sanskrit: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।\nवीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते
transliteration: duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ |\nvīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate |
meaning: He whose mind is not perturbed by pain, who has no longing for pleasures, who is free from desire, fear, and anger—he is called a sage of firm wisdom.

title: He who has no love on any side, who, upon finding good or evil, neith…
sanskrit: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्।\nनाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham |\nnābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā |
meaning: He who has no love on any side, who, upon finding good or evil, neither rejoices nor hates—his wisdom is firmly set.

title: When one is able to draw their senses away from the objects of sense…
sanskrit: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः।\nइन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: yadā sanharate chāyaṁ kūrmo ’ṅgānīva sarvaśhaḥ |\nindriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā |
meaning: When one is able to draw their senses away from the objects of sense on all sides, like a tortoise draws in its limbs, then their wisdom is firmly established.

title: The objects of the senses, except for the pleasure they bring, turn a…
sanskrit: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः।\nरसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते
transliteration: viṣhayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ |\nrasa-varjaṁ raso ’pyasya paraṁ dṛiṣhṭvā nivartate |
meaning: The objects of the senses, except for the pleasure they bring, turn away from the abstinent dweller in the body. Even the pleasure turns away from him when the Self, which is supreme over the senses, is seen.

title: The turbulent senses, O Arjuna, can forcibly carry away the mind of e…
sanskrit: यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः।\nइन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः
transliteration: yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣhasya vipaśhchitaḥ |\nindriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṁ manaḥ |
meaning: The turbulent senses, O Arjuna, can forcibly carry away the mind of even a wise man, though he is ever striving.

title: Having controlled all the senses, let him remain in contemplation, re…
sanskrit: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।\nवशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ |\nvaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā |
meaning: Having controlled all the senses, let him remain in contemplation, regarding Me as supreme; for his knowledge is firmly established when his senses are under control.

title: To one who is thinking about sense-objects, attachment to them arises…
sanskrit: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।\nसङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते
transliteration: dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate |\nsaṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate |
meaning: To one who is thinking about sense-objects, attachment to them arises; from attachment arises desire, and from desire arises anger.

title: Anger leads to delusion, which causes the loss of memory; the loss of…
sanskrit: क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः।\nस्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति
transliteration: krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛiti-vibhramaḥ |\nsmṛiti-bhranśhād buddhi-nāśho buddhi-nāśhāt praṇaśhyati |
meaning: Anger leads to delusion, which causes the loss of memory; the loss of memory leads to the destruction of discrimination, and with the destruction of discrimination, one is lost.

title: But he who goes through the sense-objects with the senses free from l…
sanskrit: रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्।\nआत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति
transliteration: rāga-dveṣha-viyuktais tu viṣhayān indriyaiśh charan |\nātma-vaśhyair-vidheyātmā prasādam adhigachchhati |
meaning: But he who goes through the sense-objects with the senses free from love and hate, disciplined and controlled, attains serenity.

title: In that serenity, all sorrow is lost; for in the case of the person w…
sanskrit: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते।\nप्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते
transliteration: prasāde sarva-duḥkhānāṁ hānir asyopajāyate |\nprasanna-chetaso hyāśhu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣhṭhate |
meaning: In that serenity, all sorrow is lost; for in the case of the person with a serene mind, the Buddhi is quickly established.

title: There is no Buddhi for the unintegrated, nor is there contemplation o…
sanskrit: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना।\nन चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्
transliteration: nāsti buddhir-ayuktasya na chāyuktasya bhāvanā |\nna chābhāvayataḥ śhāntir aśhāntasya kutaḥ sukham |
meaning: There is no Buddhi for the unintegrated, nor is there contemplation of the self for him, and without contemplation of the self, there is no peace; and for one who lacks peace, where is the happiness?

title: For, when the mind follows the senses, experiencing their objects, hi…
sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते।\nतदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि
transliteration: indriyāṇāṁ hi charatāṁ yan mano ’nuvidhīyate |\ntadasya harati prajñāṁ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi |
meaning: For, when the mind follows the senses, experiencing their objects, his understanding is carried away by them, just as the wind carries away a ship on the waters.

title: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, he whose senses are restrained from go…
sanskrit: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः।\nइन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: tasmād yasya mahā-bāho nigṛihītāni sarvaśhaḥ |\nindriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā |
meaning: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, he whose senses are restrained from going after their objects on all sides, his wisdom is firmly established.

title: What is night for all beings, in it the one who is controlled is awak…
sanskrit: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी।\nयस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः
transliteration: yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī |\nyasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśhā paśhyato muneḥ |
meaning: What is night for all beings, in it the one who is controlled is awake; when all beings are awake, that is the night for the sage who sees.

title: He into whom all desires enter, just as the waters enter the full and…
sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं
समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे
स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी
transliteration:
āpūryamāṇam achala-pratiṣhṭhaṁ |
samudram āpaḥ praviśhanti yadvat |
tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśhanti sarve |
sa śhāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī |
meaning: He into whom all desires enter, just as the waters enter the full and undisturbed sea, attains peace, and not he who longs after objects of desire.

title: The one who, abandoning all desires, abides without longing, possessi…
sanskrit: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः।\nनिर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति
transliteration: vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ |\nnirmamo nirahankāraḥ sa śhāntim adhigachchhati |
meaning: The one who, abandoning all desires, abides without longing, possession, and the sense of 'I' and 'mine', wins peace.

title: This is the Brahmic state, O Arjuna
sanskrit: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति।\nस्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति
transliteration: eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati |\nsthitvāsyām anta-kāle ’pi brahma-nirvāṇam ṛichchhati |
meaning: This is the Brahmic state, O Arjuna. No one attaining to this is deluded. By abiding in this state even at the hour of death, one will attain the Self.

title: Arjuna said, "O Krsna, if you deem knowledge to be superior to action…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन।\nतत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\njyāyasī chet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana |\ntat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśhava |
meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krsna, if you deem knowledge to be superior to action, why then do you urge me to engage in this terrible deed?"

title: You confuse my mind with statements that seem to contradict each othe…
sanskrit: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे।\nतदेकं वद निश्िचत्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्
transliteration: vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me |\ntad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām |
meaning: You confuse my mind with statements that seem to contradict each other; tell me for certain the one way by which I could reach the highest good.

title: The Lord said, "In this world, a two-fold way was of yore laid down b…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nलोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ।\nज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nloke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha |\njñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām |
meaning: The Lord said, "In this world, a two-fold way was of yore laid down by Me, O sinless one: Jnana Yoga for the Sankhyas and Karma Yoga for the Yogins."

title: No one experiences freedom from action (Naiskarmya) by abstaining fro…
sanskrit: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।\nन च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति
transliteration: na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute |\nna cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati |
meaning: No one experiences freedom from action (Naiskarmya) by abstaining from work; and no one ever attains success through mere renunciation of work.

title: No one can remain still for even a moment without doing work; for eve…
sanskrit: न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।\nकार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः
transliteration: na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit |\nkāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ |
meaning: No one can remain still for even a moment without doing work; for everyone is compelled to act, despite themselves, by the Gunas born of Nature.

title: He who, controlling the organs of action, lets his mind dwell on the…
sanskrit: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।\nइन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते
transliteration: karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran |\nindriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate |
meaning: He who, controlling the organs of action, lets his mind dwell on the objects of the senses, is a deluded person and a hypocrite.

title: But he who, subduing his senses by the mind, O Arjuna, begins to prac…
sanskrit: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।\nकर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते
transliteration: yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna |\nkarmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate |
meaning: But he who, subduing his senses by the mind, O Arjuna, begins to practice Karma Yoga through the organs of action and who is free from attachment, excels.

title: You must perform your obligatory action; for action is superior to no…
sanskrit: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।\nशरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः
transliteration: niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ |\nśharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ |
meaning: You must perform your obligatory action; for action is superior to non-action (Jñāna Yoga). For a person following non-action, not even the sustenance of the body is possible.

title: This world is held in the bondage of work only when work is not perfo…
sanskrit: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः।\nतदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर
transliteration: yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ |\ntad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara |
meaning: This world is held in the bondage of work only when work is not performed as a sacrifice. O Arjuna, you must perform work for this purpose, free from attachment.

title: In the beginning, the Lord of all beings created man along with the s…
sanskrit: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।\nअनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्
transliteration: saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ |\nanena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk |
meaning: In the beginning, the Lord of all beings created man along with the sacrifice and said, "By this shall you prosper; this shall be the cow of plenty, granting all your desires."

title: By this, please the gods, and they will support you
sanskrit: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।\nपरस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ
transliteration: devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ |\nparasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha |
meaning: By this, please the gods, and they will support you. Thus, nourishing each other, you may obtain the highest good.

title: The gods, pleased by the sacrifice, will bestow upon you the enjoymen…
sanskrit: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।\nतैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः
transliteration: iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ |\ntair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ |
meaning: The gods, pleased by the sacrifice, will bestow upon you the enjoyments you desire. He who enjoys the bounty of the gods without giving them anything in return is but a thief.

title: Pious people who eat the remnants of sacrifices are freed from all si…
sanskrit: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।\nभुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्
transliteration: yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ |\nbhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt |
meaning: Pious people who eat the remnants of sacrifices are freed from all sins, whereas those who are sinful and cook only for their own sake will only incur sin.

title: All beings arise from food; food is produced from rain; rain comes fr…
sanskrit: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।\nयज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः
transliteration: annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ |\nyajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ |
meaning: All beings arise from food; food is produced from rain; rain comes from sacrifice; and sacrifice is born of action.

title: Know that activity springs from Brahman, i.e., the physical body; Bra…
sanskrit: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।\nतस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्
transliteration: karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam |\ntasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam |
meaning: Know that activity springs from Brahman, i.e., the physical body; Brahman arises from the imperishable Self; therefore, the all-pervading Brahman is ever established in sacrifice.

title: He who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion here, lives in si…
sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः।\nअघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति
transliteration: evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ |\naghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati |
meaning: He who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion here, lives in sin, satisfying the senses, O Arjuna; he lives in vain.

title: But the man whose delight is only in the Self, who is satisfied with…
sanskrit: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः।\nआत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते
transliteration: yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ |\nātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate |
meaning: But the man whose delight is only in the Self, who is satisfied with the Self, who rejoices in the Self, for him nothing remains to be accomplished.

title: He has no purpose to gain from work done or left undone, nor does he…
sanskrit: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन।\nन चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्िचदर्थव्यपाश्रयः
transliteration: naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana |\nna chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ |
meaning: He has no purpose to gain from work done or left undone, nor does he have to rely on any end.

title: Therefore, do your work without attachment, which ought to be done
sanskrit: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।\nअसक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः
transliteration: tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara |\nasakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ |
meaning: Therefore, do your work without attachment, which ought to be done. For, a person who works without attachment attains the Supreme.

title: Indeed, Janaka and others reached perfection through Karma Yoga alone
sanskrit: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः।\nलोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि
transliteration: karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ |\nloka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi |
meaning: Indeed, Janaka and others reached perfection through Karma Yoga alone. Even recognizing its necessity for guiding the world, you must perform action.

title: Whatever a great man does, others do too
sanskrit: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।\nस यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते
transliteration: yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ |\nsa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate |
meaning: Whatever a great man does, others do too. Whatever standard he sets, the world follows it.

title: For me, Arjuna, there is nothing in all the three worlds that ought t…
sanskrit: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।\nनानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि
transliteration: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana |\nnānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi |
meaning: For me, Arjuna, there is nothing in all the three worlds that ought to be done, nor is there anything unaccomplished that ought to be accomplished. Yet I continue to work.

title: If I did not continue to work unweariedly, O Arjuna, people would fol…
sanskrit: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।\nमम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
transliteration: yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ |\nmama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ |
meaning: If I did not continue to work unweariedly, O Arjuna, people would follow my path.

title: If I do not do the work, these people will be lost; and I will be cau…
sanskrit: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।\nसङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham |\nsankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ |
meaning: If I do not do the work, these people will be lost; and I will be causing chaos in life and thereby ruining all these people.

title: Just as the ignorant, attached to their work, act, O Arjuna, so too t…
sanskrit: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत।\nकुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्िचकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्
transliteration: saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata |\nkuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham |
meaning: Just as the ignorant, attached to their work, act, O Arjuna, so too the learned should act without any attachment, and only for the welfare of the world.

title: He should not bewilder the minds of the ignorant who are attached to…
sanskrit: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्।\nजोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्
transliteration: na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām |\njoṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan |
meaning: He should not bewilder the minds of the ignorant who are attached to work; rather, he should himself perform work with devotion and cause others to do the same.

title: Actions are being performed in every way by the Gunas of Prakrti; he…
sanskrit: प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।\nअहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते
transliteration: prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ |\nahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate |
meaning: Actions are being performed in every way by the Gunas of Prakrti; he whose nature is deluded by egoism, however, thinks, 'I am the doer.'

title: But he who knows the truth about the division of the Gunas and works,…
sanskrit: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः।\nगुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते
transliteration: tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ |\nguṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate |
meaning: But he who knows the truth about the division of the Gunas and works, O mighty-armed one, through his knowledge that the Gunas 'operate on their own products,' is not attached.

title: Those who are deluded by the Gunas of Prakrti are attached to the wor…
sanskrit: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।\nतानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्
transliteration: prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu |\ntān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet |
meaning: Those who are deluded by the Gunas of Prakrti are attached to the works of the Gunas. But he who knows the whole truth should not disturb the ignorant who do not know the whole truth.

title: Surrender all your actions to Me, with a mind focused on the Self, fr…
sanskrit: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।\nनिराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः
transliteration: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā |\nnirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ |
meaning: Surrender all your actions to Me, with a mind focused on the Self, free from desire and selfishness, and fight with the heat of excitement abated.

title: Those men who, full of faith, ever practice this teaching of Mine and…
sanskrit: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः।\nश्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः
transliteration: ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ |\nśhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ |
meaning: Those men who, full of faith, ever practice this teaching of Mine and those who receive it without cavil—even they are released from karma.

title: But those who slander it, and those who do not practice this teaching…
sanskrit: ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्।\nसर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः
transliteration: ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam |\nsarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ |
meaning: But those who slander it, and those who do not practice this teaching of Mine—know them to be utterly senseless and devoid of all knowledge, and thus lost.

title: Even the man of knowledge acts according to his nature; all beings fo…
sanskrit: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि।\nप्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति
transliteration: sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api |\nprakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati |
meaning: Even the man of knowledge acts according to his nature; all beings follow their own nature. What will repression accomplish?

title: Each sense has a fixed attachment to and aversion for its correspondi…
sanskrit: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ।\nतयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ
transliteration: indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau |\ntayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau |
meaning: Each sense has a fixed attachment to and aversion for its corresponding object, but one should not come under their sway, for they are enemies.

title: Better is one's own duty, even if done poorly, than the duty of anoth…
sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।\nस्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः
transliteration: śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt |\nswa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ |
meaning: Better is one's own duty, even if done poorly, than the duty of another done well. It is better to die while performing one's own duty; the duty of another is full of fear.

title: Arjuna said, "But, O Krsna, what impels one to commit sin, even again…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nअथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।\nअनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\natha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ |\nanichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ |
meaning: Arjuna said, "But, O Krsna, what impels one to commit sin, even against their own will, as if constrained by force?"

title: The Lord said, "It is desire, it is wrath, born of the guna of rajas;…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nकाम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः।\nमहाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nkāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ |\nmahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam |
meaning: The Lord said, "It is desire, it is wrath, born of the guna of rajas; it is a great devourer, an impeller of sin. Know this to be the enemy here."

title: As a fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and…
sanskrit: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च।\nयथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्
transliteration: dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha |\nyatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam |
meaning: As a fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and as an embryo is encased in the amniotic sac, so is this world enveloped by desire.

title: The knowledge of the intelligent self is enveloped by this constant e…
sanskrit: आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।\nकामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च
transliteration: āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā |\nkāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha |
meaning: The knowledge of the intelligent self is enveloped by this constant enemy, O Arjuna, which is of the nature of desire and is difficult to gratify and insatiable.

title: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its instrument…
sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।\nएतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्
transliteration: indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate |\netair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam |
meaning: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its instruments; by these, it overpowers the embodied self, enveloping its knowledge.

title: Therefore, O Arjuna, control your senses from the outset and slay thi…
sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।\nपाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्
transliteration: tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha |\npāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam |
meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, control your senses from the outset and slay this sinful thing that destroys both knowledge and discernment.

title: They say that the senses are high, the mind is higher than the senses…
sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।\nमनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः
transliteration: indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ |\nmanasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ |
meaning: They say that the senses are high, the mind is higher than the senses, the intellect is higher than the mind, but what is greater than the intellect is that (desire).

title: Thus, knowing that which is higher than the intellect and fixing the…
sanskrit: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।\nजहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्
transliteration: evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā |\njahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam |
meaning: Thus, knowing that which is higher than the intellect and fixing the mind with the help of the intellect in Karma Yoga, O Arjuna, slay this enemy which takes the form of desire, and which is difficult to overcome.

title: The Lord said, "I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; Vivasvan…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nइमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।\nविवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nimaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam |\nvivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt |
meaning: The Lord said, "I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; Vivasvan taught it to Manu; Manu declared it to Iksvaku."

title: Thus handed down in succession, the royal sages knew this (Karma Yoga)
sanskrit: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।\nस कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप
transliteration: evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ |\nsa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa |
meaning: Thus handed down in succession, the royal sages knew this (Karma Yoga). But with a long lapse of time, O Arjuna, that Yoga was lost to the world.

title: It is the same ancient Yoga that I am now teaching you, for you are M…
sanskrit: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।\nभक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
transliteration: sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ |\nbhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam |
meaning: It is the same ancient Yoga that I am now teaching you, for you are My devotee and My friend. For, this is a supreme mystery.

title: Arjuna said, "Your birth was later, and Vivasvan's birth was earlier
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nअपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।\nकथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\naparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ |\nkatham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti |
meaning: Arjuna said, "Your birth was later, and Vivasvan's birth was earlier. How then can I understand that you taught it in the beginning?"

title: The Lord said, "Many of My births have passed, O Arjuna, as have yours
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nबहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।\nतान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nbahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna |\ntānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa |
meaning: The Lord said, "Many of My births have passed, O Arjuna, as have yours. I know them all, but you do not know them."

title: Though I am birthless and of immutable nature, and the Lord of all be…
sanskrit: अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।\nप्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया
transliteration: ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san |\nprakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā |
meaning: Though I am birthless and of immutable nature, and the Lord of all beings, yet by employing My own Nature (Prakrti), I am born out of My own free will.

title: Whenever there is a decline of Dharma, O Arjuna, and an uprising of A…
sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।\nअभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्
transliteration: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata |\nabhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham |
meaning: Whenever there is a decline of Dharma, O Arjuna, and an uprising of Adharma, then I incarnate myself.

title: For the protection of the good and the destruction of the wicked, for…
sanskrit: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।\nधर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे
transliteration: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām |\ndharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge |
meaning: For the protection of the good and the destruction of the wicked, for the establishment of Dharma, I am born from age to age.

title: He who thus knows in truth My divine birth and actions does not get r…
sanskrit: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।\nत्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन
transliteration: janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ |\ntyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna |
meaning: He who thus knows in truth My divine birth and actions does not get rebirth after leaving the body; he will come to Me, O Arjuna.

title: Freed from desire, fear, and wrath, absorbed in Me, depending upon Me…
sanskrit: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।\nबहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः
transliteration: vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ |\nbahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ |
meaning: Freed from desire, fear, and wrath, absorbed in Me, depending upon Me, purified by the austerity of knowledge, many have attained My state.

title: Whoever resorts to Me in any manner, I favor them in the same manner;…
sanskrit: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।\nमम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
transliteration: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham |\nmama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ |
meaning: Whoever resorts to Me in any manner, I favor them in the same manner; men experience Me alone in different ways, O Arjuna.

title: Those who desire the fruits of their ritualistic acts, sacrifice to t…
sanskrit: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।\nक्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा
transliteration: kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ |\nkṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā |
meaning: Those who desire the fruits of their ritualistic acts, sacrifice to the gods here; for, success quickly accrues in the world of men.

title: The system of four stations was created by Me, according to the disti…
sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः।\nतस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्
transliteration: chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ |\ntasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam |
meaning: The system of four stations was created by Me, according to the distinction of Gunas and Karma. Though I am their creator, know Me to be non-agent and immutable.

title: Works cannot contaminate Me
sanskrit: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।\nइति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते
transliteration: na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā |\niti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate |
meaning: Works cannot contaminate Me. There is no desire for the fruits of actions in Me. He who understands this is not bound by actions.

title: Knowing thus, even ancient seekers of liberation did their work
