title: Senseless people have a nature that is deluding and similar to that o…
sanskrit: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।\nराक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः
transliteration: moghāśhā mogha-karmāṇo mogha-jñānā vichetasaḥ |\nrākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ |
meaning: Senseless people have a nature that is deluding and similar to that of rakshasas and asuras. Their hopes are futile, their actions are futile, and their knowledge is futile.

title: But the great-souled ones, O Arjuna, who are associated with My divin…
sanskrit: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।\nभजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्
transliteration: mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ |\nbhajantyananya-manaso jñātvā bhūtādim avyayam |
meaning: But the great-souled ones, O Arjuna, who are associated with My divine nature, worship Me with an unwavering mind, knowing Me to be the immutable source of all beings.

title: Aspiring for eternal communion with Me, they worship Me, always singi…
sanskrit: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।\nनमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
transliteration: satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ |\nnamasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate |
meaning: Aspiring for eternal communion with Me, they worship Me, always singing My praises, striving with steadfast resolution and bowing down to Me in devotion.

title: Others, besides offering the sacrifice of knowledge, also worship Me…
sanskrit: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।\nएकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्
transliteration: jñāna-yajñena chāpyanye yajanto mām upāsate |\nekatvena pṛithaktvena bahudhā viśhvato-mukham |
meaning: Others, besides offering the sacrifice of knowledge, also worship Me as One, who is characterized by diversity in countless ways and is multiform (in My Cosmic aspect).

title: I am Kratu, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the manes, I am…
sanskrit: अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्।\nमंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्
transliteration: ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham |\nmantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam |
meaning: I am Kratu, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the manes, I am the herb, I am the Mantra, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, I am the oblation.

title: I am the father, mother, creator, and grandfather of the universe; I…
sanskrit: पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।\nवेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
transliteration: pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ |\nvedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha |
meaning: I am the father, mother, creator, and grandfather of the universe; I am the purifier. I am the syllable Om, as well as Rk, Saman, and Yajus.

title: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the r…
sanskrit: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।\nप्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्
transliteration: gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit |\nprabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam |
meaning: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, and the friend. I am the origin, the dissolution, the basis for preservation, and the imperishable seed.

title: I give heat, I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and…
sanskrit: तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।\nअमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन
transliteration: tapāmyaham ahaṁ varṣhaṁ nigṛihṇāmyutsṛijāmi cha |\namṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna |
meaning: I give heat, I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, O Arjuna. I am the being and the non-being.

title: Those who are versed in the three Vedas, having been purified from si…
sanskrit:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्
transliteration:
trai-vidyā māṁ soma-pāḥ pūta-pāpā |
yajñair iṣhṭvā svar-gatiṁ prārthayante |
te puṇyam āsādya surendra-lokam |
aśhnanti divyān divi deva-bhogān |
meaning: Those who are versed in the three Vedas, having been purified from sin by drinking the Soma juice, pray for passage to heaven and worship Me through sacrifices. Reaching the holy realm of the chief of the gods, they enjoy celestial pleasures in heaven.

title: Having enjoyed the spacious world of heaven, they return to the world…
sanskrit:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।
एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते
transliteration:
te taṁ bhuktvā swarga-lokaṁ viśhālaṁ |
kṣhīṇe puṇye martya-lokaṁ viśhanti |
evaṁ trayī-dharmam anuprapannā |
gatāgataṁ kāma-kāmā labhante |
meaning: Having enjoyed the spacious world of heaven, they return to the world of mortals, their merit having been exhausted. Thus, those who follow the Vedic rituals and are drawn by desires come and go.

title: Those who, excluding all else, think of Me and worship Me, aspiring a…
sanskrit: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।\nतेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
transliteration: ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |\nteṣhāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣhemaṁ vahāmyaham |
meaning: Those who, excluding all else, think of Me and worship Me, aspiring after eternal union with Me, I look after their prosperity and welfare (Yoga and Ksema).

title: Even those who are devoted to other divinities with faith in their he…
sanskrit: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।\nतेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्
transliteration: ye ’pyanya-devatā-bhaktā yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ |\nte ’pi mām eva kaunteya yajantyavidhi-pūrvakam |
meaning: Even those who are devoted to other divinities with faith in their hearts, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, though not in accordance with the Sastras.

title: For, I am the only enjoyer and the only Lord of all sacrifices
sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।\nन तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते
transliteration: ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha |\nna tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te |
meaning: For, I am the only enjoyer and the only Lord of all sacrifices. They do not recognize Me in My true nature; hence, they fall.

title: Devotees of gods go to the gods; manes-worshippers go to the manes; w…
sanskrit: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।\nभूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
transliteration: yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ |\nbhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām |
meaning: Devotees of gods go to the gods; manes-worshippers go to the manes; worshippers of Bhutas go to the Bhutas; and those who worship Me come to Me.

title: Whoever offers Me with true devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or so…
sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।\nतदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः
transliteration: patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati |\ntadahaṁ bhaktyupahṛitam aśhnāmi prayatātmanaḥ |
meaning: Whoever offers Me with true devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or some water, I accept this offering made with devotion by them who are pure of heart.

title: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you g…
sanskrit: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।\nयत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
transliteration: yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat |\nyat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam |
meaning: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you give away, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do that as an offering to Me.

title: Thus equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation, you will free yo…
sanskrit: शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।\nसंन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि
transliteration: śhubhāśhubha-phalair evaṁ mokṣhyase karma-bandhanaiḥ |\nsannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣhyasi |
meaning: Thus equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation, you will free yourself from the bonds of Karma, productive of both auspicious and inauspicious fruits. Thus liberated, you will come to Me.

title: I am the same to all creation; there is none hateful or dear to me
sanskrit: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।\nये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
transliteration: samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ |\nye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham |
meaning: I am the same to all creation; there is none hateful or dear to me. But those who worship me with devotion abide in me, and I in them.

title: If even the most sinful man worships Me with undivided devotion, he s…
sanskrit: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।\nसाधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
transliteration: api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk |\nsādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ |
meaning: If even the most sinful man worships Me with undivided devotion, he should be regarded as holy, for he has rightly resolved.

title: Quickly, he becomes righteous and obtains everlasting peace
sanskrit: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।\nकौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
transliteration: kṣhipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śhaśhvach-chhāntiṁ nigachchhati |\nkaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati |
meaning: Quickly, he becomes righteous and obtains everlasting peace. Affirm on My behalf, O Arjuna, that My devotee never perishes.

title: By taking refuge in Me, even those of evil birth, women, Vaisyas, and…
sanskrit: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।\nस्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
transliteration: māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ |\nstriyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim |
meaning: By taking refuge in Me, even those of evil birth, women, Vaisyas, and Sudras, attain the supreme state.

title: How much more then, for the pure Brahmanas and royal sages who are My…
sanskrit: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।\nअनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्
transliteration: kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā |\nanityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām |
meaning: How much more then, for the pure Brahmanas and royal sages who are My devotees! Having obtained this transient and joyless world, they should worship Me.

title: Focus your mind on Me, be My devotee, worship Me
sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।\nमामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः
transliteration: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru |\nmām evaiṣhyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṁ mat-parāyaṇaḥ |
meaning: Focus your mind on Me, be My devotee, worship Me. Bow down to Me. Engaging your mind in this manner and regarding Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.

title: The Lord said, "Further, O Arjuna, listen to My Supreme word
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nभूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।\nयत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nbhūya eva mahā-bāho śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ |\nyatte ’haṁ prīyamāṇāya vakṣhyāmi hita-kāmyayā |
meaning: The Lord said, "Further, O Arjuna, listen to My Supreme word. Desiring your good, I shall speak to you who loves Me."

title: Neither the host of gods nor the great sages know My power; for I am…
sanskrit: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।\nअहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः
transliteration: na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ |\naham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣhīṇāṁ cha sarvaśhaḥ |
meaning: Neither the host of gods nor the great sages know My power; for I am indeed the source of the gods and the great sages.

title: He who knows Me as unborn, without a beginning, and the great Lord of…
sanskrit: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।\nअसम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
transliteration: yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram |\nasammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣhu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramuchyate |
meaning: He who knows Me as unborn, without a beginning, and the great Lord of the worlds—he among mortals is undeluded and is released from all sin.

title: Intelligence, knowledge, non-delusion, forbearance, truth, restraint,…
sanskrit: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।\nसुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
transliteration: buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ |\nsukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo ’bhāvo bhayaṁ chābhayameva cha |
meaning: Intelligence, knowledge, non-delusion, forbearance, truth, restraint, self-control, pleasure, pain, exaltation, and depression, fear, and fearlessness;

title: Non-violence, reality, cheerfulness, austerity, beneficence, fame, an…
sanskrit: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।\nभवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
transliteration: ahiṁsā   samatā  tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ   yaśo    'yaśaḥ  bhavanti    bhāvā   bhūtānāṁ    matta   eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ |
meaning: Non-violence, reality, cheerfulness, austerity, beneficence, fame, and infamy—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

title: The seven great seers of yore, as well as the four Manus, all possess…
sanskrit: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।\nमद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā |\nmad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣhāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ |
meaning: The seven great seers of yore, as well as the four Manus, all possessing My mental disposition, were born from My mind. All these creatures of the world are descended from them.

title: He who truly knows this supreme manifestation and splendor of My ausp…
sanskrit: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।\nसोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
transliteration: etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ |\nso ’vikampena yogena yujyate nātra sanśhayaḥ |
meaning: He who truly knows this supreme manifestation and splendor of My auspicious attributes, becomes united with the unshakeable Yoga of Bhakti—there is no doubt of this.

title: I am the origin of all; from me everything proceeds
sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।\nइति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
transliteration: ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate |\niti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ |
meaning: I am the origin of all; from me everything proceeds. Thinking thus, the wise worship me with all devotion (Bhava).

title: With their minds focused on Me, their pranas centered in Me, inspirin…
sanskrit: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।\nकथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
transliteration: mach-chittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam |\nkathayantaśh cha māṁ nityaṁ tuṣhyanti cha ramanti cha |
meaning: With their minds focused on Me, their pranas centered in Me, inspiring one another and always speaking of Me, they live in contentment and bliss at all times.

title: To those who are ceaselessly united with Me and who worship Me with i…
sanskrit: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।\nददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
transliteration: teṣhāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam |\ndadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te |
meaning: To those who are ceaselessly united with Me and who worship Me with immense love, I lovingly grant that mental disposition (Buddhi-yoga) which leads them to Me.

title: Out of compassion for them alone, I, abiding in their mental activity…
sanskrit: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।\nनाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
transliteration: teṣhām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṁ tamaḥ |\nnāśhayāmyātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā |
meaning: Out of compassion for them alone, I, abiding in their mental activity as its object, dispel the darkness born of ignorance with the brilliant lamp of knowledge.

title: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nपरं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।\nपुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nparaṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān |\npuruṣhaṁ śhāśhvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum |
meaning: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the Supreme Sanctifier. All the seers proclaim You as the eternal, divine Person, the Primal Lord, the unborn, and all-pervading. So too do the divine sages Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa proclaim. You Yourself also proclaim this."

title: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the…
sanskrit: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।\nअसितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
transliteration: āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā |\nasito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ chaiva bravīṣhi me |
meaning: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the Supreme Sanctifier. All the seers proclaim You as the eternal, divine Person, the Primal Lord, the unborn, and all-pervading. So too do the divine sages Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa proclaim. You Yourself also proclaim this."

title: I deem as true all that you have said to me, O Krishna
sanskrit: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।\nन हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
transliteration: sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava |\nna hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ |
meaning: I deem as true all that you have said to me, O Krishna. Truly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons know your manifestation.

title: O Supreme Person, O Creator of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of god…
sanskrit: स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।\nभूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते
transliteration: swayam evātmanātmānaṁ vettha tvaṁ puruṣhottama |\nbhūta-bhāvana bhūteśha deva-deva jagat-pate |
meaning: O Supreme Person, O Creator of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of gods, O Ruler of the universe, You Yourself know Yourself alone.

title: You should tell Me without reserve Your divine manifestations where Y…
sanskrit: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।\nयाभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि
transliteration: vaktum arhasyaśheṣheṇa divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ |\nyābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣhṭhasi |
meaning: You should tell Me without reserve Your divine manifestations where You abide, pervading all these worlds.

title: How can I, Your devotee, know You by constantly meditating on You
sanskrit: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।\nकेषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
transliteration: kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan |\nkeṣhu keṣhu cha bhāveṣhu chintyo ’si bhagavan mayā |
meaning: How can I, Your devotee, know You by constantly meditating on You? And in what ways, O Lord, should I meditate on You?

title: Speak to me again in full, O Krishna, about Your attributes and glories
sanskrit: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।\nभूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
transliteration: vistareṇātmano yogaṁ vibhūtiṁ cha janārdana |\nbhūyaḥ kathaya tṛiptir hi śhṛiṇvato nāsti me ’mṛitam |
meaning: Speak to me again in full, O Krishna, about Your attributes and glories. For I am not sated by hearing Your ambrosial words.

title: The Lord said, "Indeed, I shall tell you, O Arjuna, My auspicious man…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nहन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।\nप्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे
transliteration: śhrī bhagavān uvācha |\nhanta te kathayiṣhyāmi divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ |\nprādhānyataḥ kuru-śhreṣhṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me |
meaning: The Lord said, "Indeed, I shall tell you, O Arjuna, My auspicious manifestations—those that are most prominent among them. There is no end to their extent."

title: I am the Self, O Arjuna, dwelling in the hearts of all beings; I am t…
sanskrit: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।\nअहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
transliteration: aham ātmā guḍākeśha sarva-bhūtāśhaya-sthitaḥ |\naham ādiśh cha madhyaṁ cha bhūtānām anta eva cha |
meaning: I am the Self, O Arjuna, dwelling in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.

title: Of the Adityas, I am Vishnu; of luminous bodies, I am the radiant sun
sanskrit: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।\nमरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी
transliteration: ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān |\nmarīchir marutām asmi nakṣhatrāṇām ahaṁ śhaśhī |
meaning: Of the Adityas, I am Vishnu; of luminous bodies, I am the radiant sun. Of the Maruts, I am Marici, and among the constellations, I am the moon.

title: Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; of gods, I am Indra; of sense-organs…
sanskrit: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।\nइन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना
transliteration: vedānāṁ sāma-vedo ’smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ |\nindriyāṇāṁ manaśh chāsmi bhūtānām asmi chetanā |
meaning: Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; of gods, I am Indra; of sense-organs, I am the mind; and of living beings, I am consciousness.

title: Of the Rudras, I am Sankara
sanskrit: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।\nवसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्
transliteration: rudrāṇāṁ śhaṅkaraśh chāsmi vitteśho yakṣha-rakṣhasām |\nvasūnāṁ pāvakaśh chāsmi meruḥ śhikhariṇām aham |
meaning: Of the Rudras, I am Sankara. Of the Yaksas and Raksasas, I am the Lord of Wealth (Kubera). Of the Vasus, I am Agni; of the mountains, I am Meru.

title: Among family priests, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief Brhaspati; of…
sanskrit: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।\nसेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः
transliteration: purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim |\nsenānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ |
meaning: Among family priests, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief Brhaspati; of generals, I am Skanda; of reservoirs of water, I am the ocean.

title: Of the great seers, I am Bhrgu; of words, I am the single-lettered wo…
sanskrit: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।\nयज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः
transliteration: maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam |\nyajñānāṁ japa-yajño ’smi sthāvarāṇāṁ himālayaḥ |
meaning: Of the great seers, I am Bhrgu; of words, I am the single-lettered word Om; of sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of Japa; of immovable things, I am the Himalayas.

title: Of trees I am the Asvattha; of celestial seers, I am Narada; of the G…
sanskrit: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।\nगन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
transliteration: aśhvatthaḥ sarva-vṛikṣhāṇāṁ devarṣhīṇāṁ cha nāradaḥ |\ngandharvāṇāṁ chitrarathaḥ siddhānāṁ kapilo muniḥ |
meaning: Of trees I am the Asvattha; of celestial seers, I am Narada; of the Gandharvas, I am Citraratha; of the perfected, I am Kapila.

title: Of horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, the nectar-born
sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।\nऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्
transliteration: uchchaiḥśhravasam aśhvānāṁ viddhi mām amṛitodbhavam |\nairāvataṁ gajendrāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ cha narādhipam |
meaning: Of horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, the nectar-born. Of lordly elephants, I am Airavata, and of men, I am the monarch.

title: Of weapons, I am the Vajra (thunderbolt); of cows, I am Kamadhuk; I a…
sanskrit: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।\nप्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः
transliteration: āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk |\nprajanaśh chāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ |
meaning: Of weapons, I am the Vajra (thunderbolt); of cows, I am Kamadhuk; I am Kandarpa, the cause of progeny; of serpents, I am Vasuki.

title: Of snakes, I am Ananta; of aquatic beings, I am Varuna; of manes, I a…
sanskrit: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।\nपितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्
transliteration: anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham |\npitṝīṇām aryamā chāsmi yamaḥ sanyamatām aham |
meaning: Of snakes, I am Ananta; of aquatic beings, I am Varuna; of manes, I am Aryama; of subduers, I am Yama.

title: Of Daityas, I am Prahlada; of reckoners, I am Death; of beasts, I am…
sanskrit: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।\nमृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्
transliteration: prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham |\nmṛigāṇāṁ cha mṛigendro ’haṁ vainateyaśh cha pakṣhiṇām |
meaning: Of Daityas, I am Prahlada; of reckoners, I am Death; of beasts, I am the lion; and of birds, I am Garuda, the son of Vinata.

title: Of moving things, I am the wind; of those who bear weapons, I am Rama…
sanskrit: पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।\nझषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी
transliteration: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham |\njhaṣhāṇāṁ makaraśh chāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī |
meaning: Of moving things, I am the wind; of those who bear weapons, I am Rama; of fishers, I am Makara; and of rivers, I am the Ganga.

title: Of creatures, I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna
sanskrit: सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।\nअध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्
transliteration: sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna |\nadhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṁ vādaḥ pravadatām aham |
meaning: Of creatures, I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna. Of sciences, I am the science of the Self (of the individual and Universal Self). Of those who argue, I am the fair reasoning.

title: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandv…
sanskrit: अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।\nअहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः
transliteration: अहमेवाक्षय: कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुख: || 33 |\nakṣharāṇām a-kāro ’smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya cha |\naham evākṣhayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśhvato-mukhaḥ |
meaning: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandva (copulative); I am myself imperishable time; I am the creator, facing all sides.

title: I am also death, which snatches away all
sanskrit: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।\nकीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
transliteration: mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām |\nkīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā |
meaning: I am also death, which snatches away all. I am the origin of all that will be born. Among women, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, endurance, and forgiveness.

title: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of…
sanskrit: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।\nमासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः
transliteration: bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham |\nmāsānāṁ mārga-śhīrṣho ’ham ṛitūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ |
meaning: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of months, I am Margasira (Nov-Dec); and of seasons, I am the season of flowers.

title: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brillian…
sanskrit: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।\nजयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्
transliteration: dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham |\njayo ’smi vyavasāyo ’smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham |
meaning: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory, I am effort; I am the magnanimity of the magnanimous.

title: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages,…
sanskrit: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।\nमुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः
transliteration: vṛiṣhṇīnāṁ vāsudevo ’smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ |\nmunīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ |
meaning: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages, I am Vyasa; and of seers, I am Usana (Sukra).

title: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment
sanskrit: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।\nमौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्
transliteration: daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām |\nmaunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham |
meaning: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment. Of those who seek victory, I am policy. Of secrets, I am also silence. And of the wise, I am wisdom.

title: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna
sanskrit: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।\nन तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
transliteration: yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna |\nna tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam |
meaning: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna. Nothing that moves or does not move exists without Me.

title: There is no limit to My divine manifestations
sanskrit: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।\nएष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया
transliteration: nānto ’sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa |\neṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā |
meaning: There is no limit to My divine manifestations. Here, I have briefly described the extent of such manifestations.

title: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know t…
sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।\nतत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्
transliteration: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā |\ntat tad evāvagachchha tvaṁ mama tejo ’nśha-sambhavam |
meaning: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know that as coming from a fragment of My power.

title: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna
sanskrit: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।\nविष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्
transliteration: atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna |\nviṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat |
meaning: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this whole universe with only a fragment of My power.

title: Arjuna said, "To show favor to me, You have told me that most profoun…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nमदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।\nयत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nmad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-sanjñitam |\nyat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama |
meaning: Arjuna said, "To show favor to me, You have told me that most profound mystery concerning the Self; by that, this delusion of mine has been dispelled."

title: O Krsna, I have heard in detail about the origin and dissolution of a…
sanskrit: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।\nत्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्
transliteration: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā |\ntvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣha māhātmyam api chāvyayam |
meaning: O Krsna, I have heard in detail about the origin and dissolution of all beings, which come from You, as well as Your immutable greatness.

title: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, so You are
sanskrit: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।\nद्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम
transliteration: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara |\ndraṣhṭum ichchhāmi te rūpam aiśhwaraṁ puruṣhottama |
meaning: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, so You are. I wish to behold Your divine form, O Supreme Person.

title: If you think, O Lord, that it can be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga…
sanskrit: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।\nयोगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्
transliteration: manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho |\nyogeśhvara tato me tvaṁ darśhayātmānam avyayam |
meaning: If you think, O Lord, that it can be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, reveal Yourself fully to me.

title: The Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, My forms, hundreds upon thousands,…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nपश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।\nनानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\npaśhya me pārtha rūpāṇi śhataśho ’tha sahasraśhaḥ |\nnānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛitīni cha |
meaning: The Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, My forms, hundreds upon thousands, manifold, divine, varied in hue and shape."

title: Behold, O Arjuna, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins,…
sanskrit: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा।\nबहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत
transliteration: paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā |\nbahūny adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvāṇi paśhyāśhcharyāṇi bhārata |
meaning: Behold, O Arjuna, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts—many marvels never seen before.

title: Behold here, O Arjuna, the entire universe with its mobile and immobi…
sanskrit: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।\nमम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि
transliteration: ihaika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ paśhyādya sa-charācharam |\nmama dehe guḍākeśha yach chānyad draṣhṭum ichchhasi |
meaning: Behold here, O Arjuna, the entire universe with its mobile and immobile things, all centered in My body, and whatever else you desire to see.

title: But you will not be able to see Me with your own eyes
sanskrit: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।\nदिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
transliteration: na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā |\ndivyaṁ dadāmi te chakṣhuḥ paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram |
meaning: But you will not be able to see Me with your own eyes. I give you a divine eye, so behold My Lordly Yoga!

title: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken, Sri Krishna, the great Lord of…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच\nएवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।\nदर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\nevam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśhvaro hariḥ |\ndarśhayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśhwaram |
meaning: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken, Sri Krishna, the great Lord of Yoga, then revealed to Arjuna the supreme, lordly form."

title: With innumerable mouths and eyes, many marvelous aspects, numerous di…
sanskrit: अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।\nअनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्
transliteration: aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśhanam |\naneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham |
meaning: With innumerable mouths and eyes, many marvelous aspects, numerous divine ornaments, and numerous divine weapons.

title: Wearing celestial garlands and raiments, anointed with divine perfume…
sanskrit: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।\nसर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्
transliteration: divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam |\nsarvāśhcharya-mayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśhvato-mukham |
meaning: Wearing celestial garlands and raiments, anointed with divine perfumes, full of wonders, resplendent, boundless, and facing all directions.

title: If a thousand suns were to rise at once in the sky, the resulting spl…
sanskrit: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।\nयदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā |\nyadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ |
meaning: If a thousand suns were to rise at once in the sky, the resulting splendour would be like the splendour of that mighty One.

title: There, Arjuna beheld the whole universe, with its manifold divisions…
sanskrit: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।\nअपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा
transliteration: tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā |\napaśhyad deva-devasya śharīre pāṇḍavas tadā |
meaning: There, Arjuna beheld the whole universe, with its manifold divisions gathered together in one single spot within the body of the God of gods.

title: Then, Arjuna, overcome with amazement, his hairs standing on end, bow…
sanskrit: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।\nप्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
transliteration: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣhṭo hṛiṣhṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ |\npraṇamya śhirasā devaṁ kṛitāñjalir abhāṣhata |
meaning: Then, Arjuna, overcome with amazement, his hairs standing on end, bowed his head to the Lord and spoke with folded hands.

title: Arjuna said, "O Lord, I behold in Your body all the gods, and all the…
sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha |
paśhyāmi devāns tava deva dehe |
sarvāns tathā bhūta-viśheṣha-saṅghān |
brahmāṇam īśhaṁ kamalāsana-stham |
ṛiṣhīnśh cha sarvān uragānśh cha divyān |
meaning: Arjuna said, "O Lord, I behold in Your body all the gods, and all the diverse hosts of beings—Brahma, Siva, who is in Brahma, the seers, and the lustrous snakes."

title: With manifold arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes, I behold Your infinit…
sanskrit:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप
transliteration:
aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṁ |
paśhyāmi tvāṁ sarvato ’nanta-rūpam |
nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ |
paśhyāmi viśhveśhvara viśhva-rūpa |
meaning: With manifold arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes, I behold Your infinite form on all sides. I see no end, no middle, nor the beginning of You, O Lord of the universe, O You of Universal Form.

title: I behold You as a mass of light, shining everywhere, with a diadem, m…
sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता
द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्
transliteration:
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakriṇaṁ cha |
tejo-rāśhiṁ sarvato dīptimantam |
paśhyāmi tvāṁ durnirīkṣhyaṁ samantād |
dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam |
meaning: I behold You as a mass of light, shining everywhere, with a diadem, mace, and discus, hard to behold, blazing like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable.

title: You are the Imperishable, Supreme One to be realized
sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे
transliteration:
tvam akṣharaṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ |
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam |
tvam avyayaḥ śhāśhvata-dharma-goptā |
sanātanas tvaṁ puruṣho mato me |
meaning: You are the Imperishable, Supreme One to be realized. You are the Supreme Substratum of this universe. You are immutable, the guardian of the eternal law; I know You are the Supreme Person who is everlasting.

title: I behold You as having no beginning, middle, or end; Your might is in…
sanskrit:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम्
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्
transliteration: स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् || 19 |
meaning: I behold You as having no beginning, middle, or end; Your might is infinite. You are endowed with an innumerable number of arms. The sun and moon are Your eyes, and Your mouth emits burning fire. With Your own radiance, You are warning the entire universe.

title: You alone have pervaded the interspace between heaven and earth, and…
sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।
दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्
transliteration:
dyāv ā-pṛithivyor idam antaraṁ hi |
vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśhaśh cha sarvāḥ |
dṛiṣhṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugraṁ tavedaṁ |
loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman |
meaning: You alone have pervaded the interspace between heaven and earth, and all the quarters. Beholding your marvelous and terrible form, O Mahatman, the three worlds are greatly overwhelmed with fear.

title: Verily, the hosts of Devas enter into You
sanskrit:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः
transliteration:
amī hi tvāṁ sura-saṅghā viśhanti |
kechid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛiṇanti |
svastīty uktvā maharṣhi-siddha-saṅghāḥ |
stuvanti tvāṁ stutibhiḥ puṣhkalābhiḥ |
meaning: Verily, the hosts of Devas enter into You. Some, in fear, extol You with clasped hands, crying "Hail!" The bands of great seers and Siddhas praise You with meaningful hymns.

title: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Visvas, the Asvi…
sanskrit:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे
transliteration:
rudrādityā vasavo ye cha sādhyā |
viśhve ’śhvinau marutaśh choṣhmapāśh cha |
gandharva-yakṣhāsura-siddha-saṅghā |
vīkṣhante tvāṁ vismitāśh chaiva sarve |
meaning: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Visvas, the Asvins, the Maruts, and the Manes, as well as the hosts of Gandharvas, Yaksas, Asuras, and Siddhas—all gaze upon You in amazement.

title: Beholding Your great form with many mouths and eyes, many arms, thigh…
sanskrit:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्
transliteration:
rūpaṁ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṁ |
mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam |
bahūdaraṁ bahu-danṣhṭrā-karālaṁ |
dṛiṣhṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham |
meaning: Beholding Your great form with many mouths and eyes, many arms, thighs, and feet, many stomachs, and terrible with many teeth, the worlds tremble, and I too quake, O mighty-armed one.

title: When I behold You touching the Supreme Heaven, shining, multicolored,…
sanskrit:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो
transliteration:
nabhaḥ-spṛiśhaṁ dīptam aneka-varṇaṁ |
vyāttānanaṁ dīpta-viśhāla-netram |
dṛiṣhṭvā hi tvāṁ pravyathitāntar-ātmā |
dhṛitiṁ na vindāmi śhamaṁ cha viṣhṇo |
meaning: When I behold You touching the Supreme Heaven, shining, multicolored, with yawning mouths and large, resplendent eyes, my inner being trembles in fear. I am unable to find support or peace, O Vishnu.

title: Viewing Your mouths, presenting awe-generating fangs and looking like…
sanskrit:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
transliteration:
danṣhṭrā-karālāni cha te mukhāni |
dṛiṣhṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni |
diśho na jāne na labhe cha śharma |
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa |
meaning: Viewing Your mouths, presenting awe-generating fangs and looking like the consuming fire of final destruction, I know not the quarters of the globe nor do I find repose. Be gracious, O Lord of the Devas! O Abode of the universe!

title: All these sons of Dhrtarastra, together with the hosts of monarchs, B…
sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः
transliteration:
amī cha tvāṁ dhṛitarāśhtrasya putrāḥ |
sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ |
bhīṣhmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau |
sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ |
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśhanti |
danṣhṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni |
kechid vilagnā daśhanāntareṣhu |
sandṛiśhyante chūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ |
meaning: All these sons of Dhrtarastra, together with the hosts of monarchs, Bhisma, Drona, and Karna, along with the leading warriors of our side,

title: Hasten to enter Your fearful mouths with terrible fangs, crushing som…
sanskrit:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः
transliteration: vaktrāṇi te  tvaramāṇā   viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni    bhayānakāni kecid   vilagnā daśanāntareṣu   sandṛśyante cūrṇitair   uttamāṅgaiḥ |
meaning: Hasten to enter Your fearful mouths with terrible fangs, crushing some of those caught between the teeth to powder.

title: As many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so do these heroes…
sanskrit:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति
transliteration:
yathā nadīnāṁ bahavo ’mbu-vegāḥ |
samudram evābhimukhā dravanti |
tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā |
viśhanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti |
meaning: As many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so do these heroes of the world of men enter into Your flaming mouths.

title: As moths rush swiftly into a blazing fire, leading to their destructi…
sanskrit:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका
स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः
transliteration:
yathā pradīptaṁ jvalanaṁ pataṅgā |
viśhanti nāśhāya samṛiddha-vegāḥ |
tathaiva nāśhāya viśhanti lokās |
tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛiddha-vegāḥ |
meaning: As moths rush swiftly into a blazing fire, leading to their destruction, so do these men swiftly rush into Your mouths, leading to their destruction.

title: Devouring all the worlds on every side with your flaming mouths, you…
sanskrit:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता
ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो
transliteration:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl |
lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ |
tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṁ |
bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣhṇo |
meaning: Devouring all the worlds on every side with your flaming mouths, you lick them up. Your fiery rays, filling the whole universe with their radiance, scorch it, O Vishnu.

title: Tell me, who are You with this terrible form
sanskrit:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्
transliteration:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo |
namo ’stu te deva-vara prasīda |
vijñātum ichchhāmi bhavantam ādyaṁ |
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛittim |
meaning: Tell me, who are You with this terrible form? Salutations to You, O Supreme God. Be gracious to me. I desire to know You, the Primal One. I do not know Your activities.

title: The Lord said, "I am the world-destroying Time
sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः
transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |
kālo ’smi loka-kṣhaya-kṛit pravṛiddho |
lokān samāhartum iha pravṛittaḥ |
ṛite ’pi tvāṁ na bhaviṣhyanti sarve |
ye ’vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣhu yodhāḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "I am the world-destroying Time. Manifesting myself fully, I have begun to destroy the worlds here. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile ranks will survive."

title: Therefore, arise, win glory
sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्
transliteration:
tasmāt tvam uttiṣhṭha yaśho labhasva |
jitvā śhatrūn bhuṅkṣhva rājyaṁ samṛiddham |
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva |
nimitta-mātraṁ bhava savya-sāchin |
meaning: Therefore, arise, win glory. Conquering your foes, enjoy a prosperous kingdom. By Me they have already been slain. You be merely an instrument, O Arjuna, you great archer!

title: Slay Drona, Bhisma, Jayadratha, Karna, as well as other mighty warrio…
sanskrit:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्
transliteration:
droṇaṁ cha bhīṣhmaṁ cha jayadrathaṁ cha |
karṇaṁ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān |
mayā hatāṁs tvaṁ jahi mā vyathiṣhṭhā |
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān |
meaning: Slay Drona, Bhisma, Jayadratha, Karna, as well as other mighty warriors who have been doomed by Me. Do not feel distressed. Fight; you shall conquer your rivals in the battle.

title: Sanjaya said, Having heard this speech of Krsna, Arjuna did Him obeis…
sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य
transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha |
etach chhrutvā vachanaṁ keśhavasya |
kṛitāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī |
namaskṛitvā bhūya evāha kṛiṣhṇaṁ |
sa-gadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya |
meaning: Sanjaya said, Having heard this speech of Krsna, Arjuna did Him obeisance; and trembling with awe, he bowed down again, and with folded palms, his voice choked with emotion, he spoke to Krsna.

title: Arjuna said, Rightly it is, O Krsna, that Your praise should move the…
sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha |
sthāne hṛiṣhīkeśha tava prakīrtyā |
jagat prahṛiṣhyaty anurajyate cha |
rakṣhānsi bhītāni diśho dravanti |
sarve namasyanti cha siddha-saṅghāḥ |
meaning: Arjuna said, Rightly it is, O Krsna, that Your praise should move the world to joy and love. The rakshasas flee in fear on all sides, and all the hosts of siddhas bow down to You.

title: (a) And why should they not, O Mahatma, bow down to You who are great…
sanskrit:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्
transliteration:
kasmāch cha te na nameran mahātman |
garīyase brahmaṇo ’py ādi-kartre |
ananta deveśha jagan-nivāsa |
tvam akṣharaṁ sad-asat tat paraṁ yat |
meaning: (a) And why should they not, O Mahatma, bow down to You who are great, being the first Creator, even of Brahma? (b) O Infinite, Lord of gods, O You who have the universe as Your abode! You are the imperishable individual self, the existent and the non-existent, and that which is beyond both.

title: (a) You are the Primal God and the Ancient One
sanskrit:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण
स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप
transliteration:
tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣhaḥ purāṇas |
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam |
vettāsi vedyaṁ cha paraṁ cha dhāma |
tvayā tataṁ viśhvam ananta-rūpa |
meaning: (a) You are the Primal God and the Ancient One. You are the Supreme resting place of the universe... (b)...You are the Knower and the object of knowledge, and the Supreme Abode. Through You, O infinite of form, is this universe pervaded.

title: (a) You are Yayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, Sashanka, Prajapati, and the gr…
sanskrit:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते
transliteration:
vāyur yamo ’gnir varuṇaḥ śhaśhāṅkaḥ |
prajāpatis tvaṁ prapitāmahaśh cha |
namo namas te ’stu sahasra-kṛitvaḥ |
punaśh cha bhūyo ’pi namo namas te |
meaning: (a) You are Yayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, Sashanka, Prajapati, and the great-grandsire. (b) Hail to You a thousand times! Hail to You again and yet again!

title: (a) Salutations to You from before and behind
sanskrit:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः
transliteration:
namaḥ purastād atha pṛiṣhṭhatas te |
namo ’stu te sarvata eva sarva |
ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṁ |
sarvaṁ samāpnoṣhi tato ’si sarvaḥ |
meaning: (a) Salutations to You from before and behind! Salutations to You from all sides, O All!৷৷. (b) ৷৷. O You of infinite prowess and heroic action, which are measureless! You pervade all beings, and therefore, You are all.

title: Unaware of Your majesty, and either out of negligence or love, or con…
sanskrit:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि
transliteration:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṁ yad uktaṁ |
he kṛiṣhṇa he yādava he sakheti |
ajānatā mahimānaṁ tavedaṁ |
mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi |
meaning: Unaware of Your majesty, and either out of negligence or love, or considering You to be a friend, whatever I have said rudely, such as 'O Krsna, O Yadava, O Comrade,'

title: And whatever disrespect has been shown to You in jest, while playing,…
sanskrit:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्
transliteration:
yach chāvahāsārtham asat-kṛito ’si |
vihāra-śhayyāsana-bhojaneṣhu |
eko ’tha vāpy achyuta tat-samakṣhaṁ |
tat kṣhāmaye tvām aham aprameyam |
meaning: And whatever disrespect has been shown to You in jest, while playing, resting, sitting, or eating, whether alone or in the presence of others, O Acyuta—I implore You for forgiveness, You who are incomprehensible.

title: You are the father of this world, of all that moves and does not move
sanskrit:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव
transliteration:
pitāsi lokasya charācharasya |
tvam asya pūjyaśh cha gurur garīyān |
na tvat-samo ’sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto ’nyo |
loka-traye ’py apratima-prabhāva |
meaning: You are the father of this world, of all that moves and does not move. You are its teacher and the one most worthy of reverence. There is none equal to You. How then could there be in the three worlds another greater than You, O Being of matchless greatness?

title: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I implore Your mercy,…
sanskrit:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्
transliteration:
tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṁ |
prasādaye tvām aham īśham īḍyam |
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ |
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum |
meaning: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I implore Your mercy, O adorable Lord. As a father listens to his son or a friend to his friend, it is fitting, O Lord, that You, who are dear to me, should bear with me who am dear to You.

title: Seeing something never seen before, I am delighted
sanskrit:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
transliteration:
adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvaṁ hṛiṣhito ’smi dṛiṣhṭvā |
bhayena cha pravyathitaṁ mano me |
tad eva me darśhaya deva rūpaṁ |
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa |
meaning: Seeing something never seen before, I am delighted. But my mind is also filled with awe. Show me, O Lord! Your other form. O Lord of the gods! Be gracious, O Abode of the universe!

title: I wish to see You ever as before, with crown and mace and discus in hand
sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त
मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते
transliteration:
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakra-hastam |
ichchhāmi tvāṁ draṣhṭum ahaṁ tathaiva |
tenaiva rūpeṇa chatur-bhujena |
sahasra-bāho bhava viśhva-mūrte |
meaning: I wish to see You ever as before, with crown and mace and discus in hand. Assume again that four-armed shape, O Thou the thousand-armed, of Universal Form!

title: The Lord said, "By My grace, O Arjuna, this Supreme Form, luminous, u…
sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्
transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṁ |
rūpaṁ paraṁ darśhitam ātma-yogāt |
tejo-mayaṁ viśhvam anantam ādyaṁ |
yan me tvad anyena na dṛiṣhṭa-pūrvam |
meaning: The Lord said, "By My grace, O Arjuna, this Supreme Form, luminous, universal, infinite, and primal—never seen before by anyone but you—has been revealed to you through My own free will."

title: Neither through the study of the Vedas, nor by sacrifices, nor by rec…
sanskrit:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै
र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर
transliteration:
na veda-yajñādhyayanair na dānair |
na cha kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ |
evaṁ-rūpaḥ śhakya ahaṁ nṛi-loke |
draṣhṭuṁ tvad anyena kuru-pravīra |
meaning: Neither through the study of the Vedas, nor by sacrifices, nor by recitations of the scriptures, nor by gifts, nor by rituals, nor by strict austerities can I be realized in a form like this in the world of men by anyone else but you. O Arjuna!

title: You need not fear any longer, nor be perplexed, looking upon this awe…
sanskrit:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य
transliteration:
mā te vyathā mā cha vimūḍha-bhāvo |
dṛiṣhṭvā rūpaṁ ghoram īdṛiṅ mamedam |
vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṁ |
tad eva me rūpam idaṁ prapaśhya |
meaning: You need not fear any longer, nor be perplexed, looking upon this awe-inspiring form of Mine. Free from fear and with a gladdened heart, behold once again that other form of Mine.

title: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Sri Krsna once more revea…
sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा
transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha |
ity arjunaṁ vāsudevas tathoktvā |
svakaṁ rūpaṁ darśhayām āsa bhūyaḥ |
āśhvāsayām āsa cha bhītam enaṁ |
bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā |
meaning: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Sri Krsna once more revealed His own form. The Mahatman, assuming a benign form again, reassured him who had been struck with awe.

title: Arjuna said, "Having beheld Your human and pleasing form, O Krsna, I…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nदृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन।\nइदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\ndṛiṣhṭvedaṁ mānuṣhaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana |\nidānīm asmi saṁvṛittaḥ sa-chetāḥ prakṛitiṁ gataḥ |
meaning: Arjuna said, "Having beheld Your human and pleasing form, O Krsna, I am now composed in mind and have been restored to my normal nature."

title: The Lord said, "It is very hard to behold this form of Mine which you…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nसुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।\nदेवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nsu-durdarśham idaṁ rūpaṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi yan mama |\ndevā apy asya rūpasya nityaṁ darśhana-kāṅkṣhiṇaḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "It is very hard to behold this form of Mine which you have seen. Even the gods everlong to behold this form."

title: Sri Krishna says, "I cannot be seen in such a form as You have seen M…
sanskrit: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।\nशक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा
transliteration: nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na chejyayā |\nśhakya evaṁ-vidho draṣhṭuṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi māṁ yathā |
meaning: Sri Krishna says, "I cannot be seen in such a form as You have seen Me, not by the Vedas, nor by austerities, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifice."

title: But by single-minded devotion, O Arjuna, it is possible to truly know…
sanskrit: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।\nज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप
transliteration: bhaktyā tv ananyayā śhakya aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna |\njñātuṁ draṣhṭuṁ cha tattvena praveṣhṭuṁ cha parantapa |
meaning: But by single-minded devotion, O Arjuna, it is possible to truly know, to see, and to enter into Me, who am of this form, O harasser of foes.

title: Whoever works for Me, regards Me as the highest and is devoted to Me,…
sanskrit: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।\nनिर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव
transliteration: mat-karma-kṛin mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ |\nnirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣhu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava |
meaning: Whoever works for Me, regards Me as the highest and is devoted to Me, free from attachment and without animosity towards any creature, they come to Me, O Arjuna.

title: Arjuna said: Which of these has greater knowledge of yoga—those devot…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nevaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate |\nye chāpy akṣharam avyaktaṁ teṣhāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ |
meaning: Arjuna said: Which of these has greater knowledge of yoga—those devotees who meditate on You, ever integrated, or those who meditate on the Imperishable and the Unmanifest?

title: The Lord said, "Those who, ever integrated with Me and possessing sup…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nmayy āveśhya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate |\nśhraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "Those who, ever integrated with Me and possessing supreme faith, worship Me, focusing their minds on Me—these are considered by Me to be the highest among the yogis."

title: But those who meditate on the Imperishable, the indefinable, the unma…
sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्
transliteration:
ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate |
sarvatra-gam achintyañcha kūṭa-stham achalandhruvam |
sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ |
te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ |
meaning: But those who meditate on the Imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, omnipresent, unthinkable, common to all beings, immovable, and constant—

title: Having subdued all the senses, being even-minded, and engaged in the…
sanskrit: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः
transliteration: sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ  sarvatra    sama-buddhayaḥ  te  prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite    ratāḥ |
meaning: Having subdued all the senses, being even-minded, and engaged in the welfare of all beings, they too come to Me only.

title: Greater is the difficulty for those whose minds are thus attached to…
sanskrit: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।\nअव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
transliteration: kleśho ’dhikataras teṣhām avyaktāsakta-chetasām |\navyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate |
meaning: Greater is the difficulty for those whose minds are thus attached to the unmanifest, for the way of the unmanifest is hard to reach for embodied beings.

title: For those who dedicate all their actions to Me, hold Me as their supr…
sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते
transliteration: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ |\nananyenaiva yogena māṁ dhyāyanta upāsate |
meaning: For those who dedicate all their actions to Me, hold Me as their supreme goal, are intent on Me, and worship Me, meditating on Me with exclusive devotion;

title: Those whose minds are thus focused on Me, I soon become their savior…
sanskrit: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्
transliteration: teṣhām ahaṁ samuddhartā mṛityu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt |\nbhavāmi na chirāt pārtha mayy āveśhita-chetasām |
meaning: Those whose minds are thus focused on Me, I soon become their savior from the ocean of mortal life.

title: Focus your mind on Me alone; and let your intellect enter into Me
sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः
transliteration: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya |\nnivasiṣhyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na sanśhayaḥ |
meaning: Focus your mind on Me alone; and let your intellect enter into Me. Then, you will live in Me alone; there is no doubt.

title: If now you are unable to focus your mind on Me, then seek to reach Me…
sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय
transliteration: atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram |\nabhyāsa-yogena tato mām ichchhāptuṁ dhanañjaya |
meaning: If now you are unable to focus your mind on Me, then seek to reach Me, O Arjuna, through the practice of repetition.

title: If you are incapable of even this practice of repetition, then devote…
sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: abhyāse ’py asamartho ’si mat-karma-paramo bhava |\nmad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi |
meaning: If you are incapable of even this practice of repetition, then devote yourself to My deeds. For even by working for My sake, you will attain perfection.

title: If you are unable to do even this—that is, take refuge in My Yoga—the…
sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्
transliteration: athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ |\nsarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān |
meaning: If you are unable to do even this—that is, take refuge in My Yoga—then, with your self-control, renounce the fruits of every action.

title: Far better is knowledge of the Self than the repeated practice (of re…
sanskrit: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्
transliteration: śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate |\ndhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāch chhāntir anantaram |
meaning: Far better is knowledge of the Self than the repeated practice (of remembrance of the Lord). Better is meditation than this knowledge; better is renunciation of the fruits of action than meditation. From such renunciation, peace ensues.

title: He who never hates any being, who is friendly and compassionate, who…
sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी
transliteration: adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha |\nnirmamo nirahankāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣhamī |
meaning: He who never hates any being, who is friendly and compassionate, who is free from the feelings of "I" and "mine," who looks upon all pain and pleasure equally, and who is enduring;

title: He who is content, who meditates ever, is self-restrained, and is fir…
sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
transliteration: santuṣhṭaḥ satataṁ yogī yatātmā dṛiḍha-niśhchayaḥ |\nmayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ |
meaning: He who is content, who meditates ever, is self-restrained, and is firm in his convictions, and has his mind and reason dedicated to Me—he is dear to Me.

title: He from whom the world has no cause to be frightened, who is not frig…
sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
transliteration: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ |\nharṣhāmarṣha-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa cha me priyaḥ |
meaning: He from whom the world has no cause to be frightened, who is not frightened by the world, who is free from joy and impatience, fear, and aversion - he is dear to me.

title: He who is free from desires, who is pure, expert, indifferent, and fr…
sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
transliteration: anapekṣhaḥ śhuchir dakṣha udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ |\nsarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ |
meaning: He who is free from desires, who is pure, expert, indifferent, and free from agony, who has renounced every undertaking—he is dear to me.

title: He who does not rejoice, nor hate, nor grieve, nor desire, who renoun…
sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः
transliteration: yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati |\nśhubhāśhubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ |
meaning: He who does not rejoice, nor hate, nor grieve, nor desire, who renounces both good and evil, and who is full of devotion to Me—such a devotee is dear to Me.

title: He who is the same to foe and friend, honor and dishonor, who is alik…
sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः
transliteration: samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ |\nśhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ |
meaning: He who is the same to foe and friend, honor and dishonor, who is alike to both cold and heat, pleasure and pain, and who is free from all attachments;

title: He who regards both blame and praise alike, who is silent and content…
sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः
transliteration: tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣhṭo yena kenachit |\naniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ |
meaning: He who regards both blame and praise alike, who is silent and content with any lot, who has no home, who is firm of mind, and who is devoted to Me - such a man is dear to Me.

title: But those devotees who follow this nectar of virtuous duty, as taught…
sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः
transliteration: ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate |\nśhraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te ’tīva me priyāḥ |
meaning: But those devotees who follow this nectar of virtuous duty, as taught above, who are full of faith and regard Me as the Supreme, are exceedingly dear to Me.

title: This is not a sentence, so there is nothing to fix
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nप्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च।\nएतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nprakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva kṣhetraṁ kṣhetra-jñam eva cha |\netad veditum ichchhāmi jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ cha keśhava |
meaning: This is not a sentence, so there is nothing to fix.

title: The Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the Field, Ksetra
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nidaṁ śharīraṁ kaunteya kṣhetram ity abhidhīyate |\netad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣhetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the Field, Ksetra. Those who know the self call the one who knows it the Field-knower, Ksetrajna."

title: And know Me also as the Knower of all Fields, O Arjuna
sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।\nक्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम
transliteration: kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata |\nkṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama |
meaning: And know Me also as the Knower of all Fields, O Arjuna. In My view, the knowledge of the Field and its Knower is the true knowledge.

title: Listen briefly from Me what the Field is, what it is like, what its m…
sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु
transliteration: tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat |\nsa cha yo yat-prabhāvaśh cha tat samāsena me śhṛiṇu |
meaning: Listen briefly from Me what the Field is, what it is like, what its modifications are, what purpose it serves, and what it is; as well as who the Self is and what its powers are.

title: It has been sung by seers in various ways, in various distinctive hym…
sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः
transliteration: ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak |\nbrahma-sūtra-padaiśh chaiva hetumadbhir viniśhchitaiḥ |
meaning: It has been sung by seers in various ways, in various distinctive hymns, and also in the well-reasoned and conclusive words of the Brahma-sutras.

title: The great elements, the Ahankara, the Buddhi, the Avyakta, the ten se…
sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः
transliteration: mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha |\nindriyāṇi daśhaikaṁ cha pañcha chendriya-gocharāḥ |
meaning: The great elements, the Ahankara, the Buddhi, the Avyakta, the ten senses, and the one, in addition, the five objects of the senses;

title: Desire, hatred, pleasure, and pain, and the combination that constitu…
sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ |\netat kṣhetraṁ samāsena sa-vikāram udāhṛitam |
meaning: Desire, hatred, pleasure, and pain, and the combination that constitutes the basis of consciousness—or the individual self—have been briefly described here, along with their modifications.

title: Modesty, absence of ostentation, non-injury, patience, sincerity, ser…
sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः
transliteration: amānitvam adambhitvam ahinsā kṣhāntir ārjavam |\nāchāryopāsanaṁ śhauchaṁ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ |
meaning: Modesty, absence of ostentation, non-injury, patience, sincerity, service to the preceptor, purity, firmness, and self-restraint;

title: Absence of desire for sense-objects, and also absence of egotism, the…
sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्
transliteration: indriyārtheṣhu vairāgyam anahankāra eva cha |\njanma-mṛityu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣhānudarśhanam |
meaning: Absence of desire for sense-objects, and also absence of egotism, the recognition of evil in birth, death, old age, disease, and sorrow;

title: Non-attachment, absence of clinging to son, wife, home, and the like,…
sanskrit: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु
transliteration: asaktir anabhiṣhvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛihādiṣhu |\nnityaṁ cha sama-chittatvam iṣhṭāniṣhṭopapattiṣhu |
meaning: Non-attachment, absence of clinging to son, wife, home, and the like, and constant even-mindedness in regard to all desirable and undesirable events;

title: Constantly devote yourself to Me alone, resort to solitary places, an…
sanskrit: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि
transliteration: mayi chānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhichāriṇī |\nvivikta-deśha-sevitvam aratir jana-sansadi |
meaning: Constantly devote yourself to Me alone, resort to solitary places, and dislike crowds.

title: Constant contemplation on the knowledge pertaining to the self, refle…
sanskrit: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा
transliteration: adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṁ tattva-jñānārtha-darśhanam |\netaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato ’nyathā |
meaning: Constant contemplation on the knowledge pertaining to the self, reflection for the attainment of knowledge of the truth—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is contrary to it is ignorance.

title: I shall declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains…
sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते
transliteration: jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute |\nanādi mat-paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad uchyate |
meaning: I shall declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains the immortal Self. It is beginningless Brahman, having Me as the Highest (Anadi Matparam); it is said to be neither being nor non-being.

title: Its hands and feet are everywhere; Its eyes, heads, and mouths are ev…
sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṁ tat sarvato ’kṣhi-śhiro-mukham |\nsarvataḥ śhrutimal loke sarvam āvṛitya tiṣhṭhati |
meaning: Its hands and feet are everywhere; Its eyes, heads, and mouths are everywhere; Its ears are on all sides; and It exists, encompassing all things.

title: Shining by the functions of the senses, yet devoid of the senses, det…
sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च
transliteration: sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṁ sarvendriya-vivarjitam |\nasaktaṁ sarva-bhṛich chaiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛi cha |
meaning: Shining by the functions of the senses, yet devoid of the senses, detached yet supporting all, devoid of the Gunas yet experiencing the Gunas;

title: It is within and without all beings; It is unmoving yet moving; It is…
sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्
transliteration: bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha |\nsūkṣhmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ chāntike cha tat |
meaning: It is within and without all beings; It is unmoving yet moving; It is so subtle that none can comprehend it; It is far away yet very near.

title: Undivided yet appearing as if divided among beings, this Self is to b…
sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च
transliteration: avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam |\nbhūta-bhartṛi cha taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣhṇu prabhaviṣhṇu cha |
meaning: Undivided yet appearing as if divided among beings, this Self is to be known as the supporter of the elements. It devours them and causes their generation.

title: The light of all lights is said to be beyond Tamas (darkness); it is…
sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्
transliteration: jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate |\njñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛidi sarvasya viṣhṭhitam |
meaning: The light of all lights is said to be beyond Tamas (darkness); it is known to be knowledge, to be attained through knowledge, and to be present in the hearts of all.

title: Thus, the Ksetra, knowledge, and the object of knowledge have been br…
sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते
transliteration: iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ |\nmad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate |
meaning: Thus, the Ksetra, knowledge, and the object of knowledge have been briefly set forth. On knowing this, My devotee becomes fit to attain My state.

title: Know that both Prakṛti and the Self (Puruṣa) are without beginning; k…
sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्
transliteration: prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api |\nvikārānśh cha guṇānśh chaiva viddhi prakṛiti-sambhavān |
meaning: Know that both Prakṛti and the Self (Puruṣa) are without beginning; know that all modifications and the attributes are born from Prakṛti.

title: The Prakṛti is said to be the cause of agency to the body (Kārya) and…
sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते
transliteration: kārya-kāraṇa-kartṛitve hetuḥ prakṛitir uchyate |\npuruṣhaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṁ bhoktṛitve hetur uchyate |
meaning: The Prakṛti is said to be the cause of agency to the body (Kārya) and sense-organs (Karaṇa); the Self is said to be the cause of experiencing pleasure and pain.

title: (a) Indeed, the self seated in Prakrti experiences the Gunas born of…
sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु
transliteration: puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān |\nkāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo ’sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu |
meaning: (a) Indeed, the self seated in Prakrti experiences the Gunas born of Prakrti. (b) Its attachment to these Gunas is the cause of birth in good and evil wombs.

title: The self in the body is called the spectator, approver, supporter, ex…
sanskrit: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः
transliteration: upadraṣhṭānumantā cha bhartā bhoktā maheśhvaraḥ |\nparamātmeti chāpy ukto dehe ’smin puruṣhaḥ paraḥ |
meaning: The self in the body is called the spectator, approver, supporter, experiencer, great lord, and supreme self.

title: He who understands the Self and Prakriti, along with the Gunas, will…
sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते
transliteration: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha |\nsarvathā vartamāno ’pi na sa bhūyo ’bhijāyate |
meaning: He who understands the Self and Prakriti, along with the Gunas, will not be born again, no matter what state he may be in.

title: Some perceive the Self within the self (body) through meditation of t…
sanskrit: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
transliteration: dhyānenātmani paśhyanti kechid ātmānam ātmanā |\nanye sānkhyena yogena karma-yogena chāpare |
meaning: Some perceive the Self within the self (body) through meditation of the mind, others through Sankhya Yoga, and still others through Karma Yoga.

title: But some, who do not know this, having heard from others, worship acc…
sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः
transliteration: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate |\nte ’pi chātitaranty eva mṛityuṁ śhruti-parāyaṇāḥ |
meaning: But some, who do not know this, having heard from others, worship accordingly—these too, devoted to what they hear, pass beyond death.

title: Whatever being is born, whether it be moving or stationary, know, O A…
sanskrit: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ
transliteration: yāvat sañjāyate kiñchit sattvaṁ sthāvara-jaṅgamam |\nkṣhetra-kṣhetrajña-sanyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣhabha |
meaning: Whatever being is born, whether it be moving or stationary, know, O Arjuna, that it is through the combination of the Ksetra (body) and Ksetrajna (knower of the Field).

title: Who sees the supreme ruler dwelling alike in all bodies and never per…
sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
transliteration: samaṁ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu tiṣhṭhantaṁ parameśhvaram |\nvinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati |
meaning: Who sees the supreme ruler dwelling alike in all bodies and never perishing, even when they perish, he indeed sees.

title: For, seeing the ruler abiding alike in every place, he does not injur…
sanskrit: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्
transliteration: samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram |\nna hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim |
meaning: For, seeing the ruler abiding alike in every place, he does not injure himself with his own mind and therefore reaches the highest goal.

title: He who sees that all acts are done universally by Prakrti alone, and…
sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति
