transliteration: prakṛityaiva cha karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśhaḥ |\nyaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati |
meaning: He who sees that all acts are done universally by Prakrti alone, and likewise that the self is not the doer, he indeed sees.

title: When he perceives the independent modes of existence of all beings ce…
sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा
transliteration: yadā bhūta-pṛithag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśhyati |\ntata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā |
meaning: When he perceives the independent modes of existence of all beings centered in one, and their expansion from it alone, then he attains Brahman.

title: This supreme Self, though dwelling in the body, is immutable, O Arjun…
sanskrit: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते
transliteration: anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ |\nśharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate |
meaning: This supreme Self, though dwelling in the body, is immutable, O Arjuna, being without beginning. It neither acts nor is tainted, as it is without Gunas.

title: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted due to its subtlety, even s…
sanskrit: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते
transliteration: yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣhmyād ākāśhaṁ nopalipyate |\nsarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate |
meaning: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted due to its subtlety, even so, the self abiding in the body is not tainted everywhere.

title: As the one sun illuminates this entire world, so does the Knower of t…
sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत
transliteration: yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ |\nkṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata |
meaning: As the one sun illuminates this entire world, so does the Knower of the Field (Ksetrin, the self), O Arjuna, illuminate the entire Field (the body).

title: Those who thus discern, with the eye of knowledge, the difference bet…
sanskrit: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
transliteration: kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā |\nbhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param |
meaning: Those who thus discern, with the eye of knowledge, the difference between the body or the Field (Ksetra) and the knower of the body or Field-knower (Ksetrajna), and the means of deliverance from the manifested Prakrti, they attain the Supreme.

title: The Lord said, "I shall declare again another kind of knowledge: It i…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nparaṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam |\nyaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "I shall declare again another kind of knowledge: It is the best of all forms of knowledge, by knowing which all the sages have attained the state of perfection beyond this world."

title: Resorting to this knowledge, partaking in My Nature, they are not bor…
sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
transliteration: idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ |\nsarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha |
meaning: Resorting to this knowledge, partaking in My Nature, they are not born at the time of creation nor do they suffer at the time of dissolution.

title: My womb is the great Brahman (i.e
sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत
transliteration: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham |\nsambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata |
meaning: My womb is the great Brahman (i.e. Prakṛti). In it, I lay the germ. From that, O Arjuna, comes the birth of all beings.

title: Whatever forms are produced in any womb, O Arjuna, the Prakṛti is the…
sanskrit: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता
transliteration: sarva-yoniṣhu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ |\ntāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā |
meaning: Whatever forms are produced in any womb, O Arjuna, the Prakṛti is their great womb, and I am the sowing father.

title: The Gunas of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas arise from Prakrti and bind the…
sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्
transliteration: sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ |\nnibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam |
meaning: The Gunas of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas arise from Prakrti and bind the immutable Self in the body, O Arjuna.

title: Of these, sattva, being without impurity, is luminous and free from m…
sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ
transliteration: tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśhakam anāmayam |\nsukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena chānagha |
meaning: Of these, sattva, being without impurity, is luminous and free from morbidity. It binds, O Arjuna, through attachment to pleasure and knowledge.

title: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion springing from…
sanskrit: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
transliteration: rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛiṣhṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam |\ntan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam |
meaning: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion springing from thirst and attachment. It binds the embodied self with attachment to action.

title: Know that Tamas is born of false knowledge and deludes all embodied b…
sanskrit: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत
transliteration: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām |\npramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata |
meaning: Know that Tamas is born of false knowledge and deludes all embodied beings. It binds, O Arjuna, with negligence, indolence, and sleep.

title: Sattva generates attachment to pleasure, Rajas to action, O Arjuna
sanskrit: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत
transliteration: sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata |\njñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta |
meaning: Sattva generates attachment to pleasure, Rajas to action, O Arjuna. But Tamas, obscuring knowledge, generates attachment to negligence.

title: Prevailing over Rajas and Tamas, Sattva predominates, O Arjuna
sanskrit: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
transliteration: rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata |\nrajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā |
meaning: Prevailing over Rajas and Tamas, Sattva predominates, O Arjuna. Prevailing over Tamas and Sattva, Rajas predominates. Prevailing over Rajas and Sattva, Tamas predominates.

title: When knowledge, like light, illuminates from all gateways (i.e., the…
sanskrit: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
transliteration: sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate |\njñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta |
meaning: When knowledge, like light, illuminates from all gateways (i.e., the senses), then one should know that Sattva prevails.

title: Greed, activity, undertaking of work, restlessness, and longing—these…
sanskrit: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
transliteration: lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā |\nrajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha |
meaning: Greed, activity, undertaking of work, restlessness, and longing—these arise, O Arjuna, when Rajas predominates.

title: Non-illumination, inactivity, negligence, and even delusion—these ari…
sanskrit: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
transliteration: aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha |\ntamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana |
meaning: Non-illumination, inactivity, negligence, and even delusion—these arise, O Arjuna, when Tamas prevails.

title: If the embodied self dissolves when Sattva prevails, then it proceeds…
sanskrit: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
transliteration: yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit |\ntadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate |
meaning: If the embodied self dissolves when Sattva prevails, then it proceeds to the pure worlds of those who know the highest.

title: (a) When Rajas is prevalent, one meets with dissolution and is born a…
sanskrit: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
transliteration: rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣhu jāyate |\ntathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate |
meaning: (a) When Rajas is prevalent, one meets with dissolution and is born among those attached to work. (b) Similarly, when Tamas prevails, one who has met with dissolution is born in the womb of beings lacking intelligence.

title: It is said that the fruit of a good deed is pure and of the nature of…
sanskrit: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
transliteration: karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam |\nrajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam |
meaning: It is said that the fruit of a good deed is pure and of the nature of Sattva; the fruit of Rajas is pain; and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.

title: From Sattva arises knowledge, from Rajas arises greed, from Tamas ari…
sanskrit: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
transliteration: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha |\npramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato ’jñānam eva cha |
meaning: From Sattva arises knowledge, from Rajas arises greed, from Tamas arises negligence and delusion, and from it arises ignorance.

title: Those who rest in Sattva ascend upwards; those who abide in Rajas sta…
sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
transliteration: ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ |\njaghanya-guṇa-vṛitti-sthā adho gachchhanti tāmasāḥ |
meaning: Those who rest in Sattva ascend upwards; those who abide in Rajas stay in the middle; and those, abiding in the tendencies of Tamas descend downwards.

title: When the seer beholds no agent of action other than the Gunas, and kn…
sanskrit: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
transliteration: nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣhṭānupaśhyati |\nguṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati |
meaning: When the seer beholds no agent of action other than the Gunas, and knows what is beyond the Gunas, he attains to My state.

title: The embodied Self, crossing beyond these three Gunas that arise in th…
sanskrit: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
transliteration: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān |\njanma-mṛityu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto ’mṛitam aśhnute |
meaning: The embodied Self, crossing beyond these three Gunas that arise in the body, and being freed from birth, death, aging, and pain, attains immortality.

title: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of a person who has transcended the…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nkair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho |\nkim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate |
meaning: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of a person who has transcended the three Gunas? What is their behavior? And how do they transcend the three Gunas?"

title: The Lord said, "He does not hate illumination, nor activity, nor even…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nprakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava |\nna dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati |
meaning: The Lord said, "He does not hate illumination, nor activity, nor even delusion, O Arjuna, while these prevail, nor does He long for them when they cease."

title: He who sits like one unconcerned, undisturbed by the Gunas; who knows…
sanskrit: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
transliteration: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate |\nguṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate |
meaning: He who sits like one unconcerned, undisturbed by the Gunas; who knows, 'It is the Gunas that are in motion,' and so remains unshaken;

title: He who is alike in pleasure and pain, who dwells in his Self, who loo…
sanskrit: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः
transliteration: sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ |\ntulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-sanstutiḥ |
meaning: He who is alike in pleasure and pain, who dwells in his Self, who looks upon a clod, a stone, and a piece of gold as of equal value, who remains the same towards things dear and hateful, and who is intelligent, who regards both blame and praise of himself as equal.

title: He who is the same in honor and dishonor, and the same to friend and…
sanskrit: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते
transliteration: mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣhayoḥ |\nsarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa uchyate |
meaning: He who is the same in honor and dishonor, and the same to friend and foe, and who has abandoned all enterprises—he is said to have risen above the Gunas.

title: And he who, with unwavering devotion through Yoga, serves Me, he, tra…
sanskrit: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
transliteration: māṁ cha yo ’vyabhichāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate |\nsa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate |
meaning: And he who, with unwavering devotion through Yoga, serves Me, he, transcending the Gunas, becomes fit for the state of Brahman.

title: For I am the ground of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and eternal…
sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
transliteration: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣhṭhāham amṛitasyāvyayasya cha |\nśhāśhvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya cha |
meaning: For I am the ground of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and eternal Dharma, and perfect bliss.

title: The Lord said, "They speak of an immutable Asvattha tree with its roo…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śhākham aśhvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam |\nchhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit |
meaning: The Lord said, "They speak of an immutable Asvattha tree with its roots above and branches below; its leaves are the Vedas. He who knows it knows the Vedas."

title: (a) Its branches extend both above and below, nourished by the Gunas
sanskrit: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि     कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके
transliteration:
adhaśh chordhvaṁ prasṛitās tasya śhākhā |
guṇa-pravṛiddhā viṣhaya-pravālāḥ |
adhaśh cha mūlāny anusantatāni |
karmānubandhīni manuṣhya-loke |
meaning: (a) Its branches extend both above and below, nourished by the Gunas. Their shoots are sense objects. (b) And their secondary roots extend downwards, resulting in actions that bind in the world of humans.

title: Its form is not perceived here, nor its end, nor its beginning, nor i…
sanskrit: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल    मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा
transliteration:
na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate |
nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā |
aśhvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam |
asaṅga-śhastreṇa dṛiḍhena chhittvā |
meaning: Its form is not perceived here, nor its end, nor its beginning, nor its support. Having cut off this firmly-rooted Asvattha with the strong axe of detachment.

title: Then, one should seek that goal, attaining which one never returns
sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी
transliteration:
tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ |
yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ |
tam eva chādyaṁ puruṣhaṁ prapadye |
yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī |
meaning: Then, one should seek that goal, attaining which one never returns. One should seek refuge with that Primal Person from whom this ancient activity streamed forth.

title: Without the delusion of perverse notions concerning the self, victori…
sanskrit: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्
transliteration:
nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā |
adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ |
dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair |
gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat |
meaning: Without the delusion of perverse notions concerning the self, victorious over the evil of attachment, ever devoted to the Self, turned away from desires and liberated from dualities such as pleasure and pain, the undeluded go to that imperishable state.

title: That supreme light, upon reaching which they do not return any more,…
sanskrit: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
transliteration: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ |\nyad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama |
meaning: That supreme light, upon reaching which they do not return any more, is Mine; neither the sun nor the moon nor the fire illuminates It.

title: An everlasting part of Myself, having become the bound self in the wo…
sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति
transliteration: mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ |\nmanaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati |
meaning: An everlasting part of Myself, having become the bound self in the world of life, attracts the senses, of which the mind is the sixth, and which abide in Prakriti.

title: Whatever body its lord acquires and from whatever body it departs, it…
sanskrit: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्
transliteration: śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ |\ngṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt |
meaning: Whatever body its lord acquires and from whatever body it departs, it goes on its way, taking these senses as the wind carries scents from their places.

title: Presiding over the ear, the eye, the sense of touch, the tongue, the…
sanskrit: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते
transliteration: śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha |\nadhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate |
meaning: Presiding over the ear, the eye, the sense of touch, the tongue, the nose, and the mind, It experiences these objects of the senses.

title: The deluded do not perceive it conjoined with the Gunas when departin…
sanskrit: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
transliteration: utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam |\nvimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ |
meaning: The deluded do not perceive it conjoined with the Gunas when departing, staying, or experiencing. Those who have the eye of knowledge, however, see it.

title: The striving yogis perceive it established in themselves
sanskrit: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः
transliteration: yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam |\nyatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ |
meaning: The striving yogis perceive it established in themselves. But, though striving, those of unrefined minds, devoid of intelligence, do not perceive it.

title: Know that the brilliance which illumines the whole universe in the su…
sanskrit: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्
transliteration: yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam |\nyach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam |
meaning: Know that the brilliance which illumines the whole universe in the sun, the moon, and fire is Mine.

title: And, entering the earth, I uphold all beings with My strength
sanskrit: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
transliteration: gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā |\npuṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ |
meaning: And, entering the earth, I uphold all beings with My strength. I nourish all herbs, becoming the juicy Soma.

title: Becoming the digestive fire, I function within the bodies of all livi…
sanskrit: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्
transliteration: ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ |\nprāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham |
meaning: Becoming the digestive fire, I function within the bodies of all living beings. In union with the inward and outward breath, I digest the four kinds of food.

title: And I am seated in the hearts of all
sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्
transliteration:
sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo |
mattaḥ smṛitir jñānam apohanaṁ cha |
vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo |
vedānta-kṛid veda-vid eva chāham |
meaning: And I am seated in the hearts of all. From Me come memory, knowledge, and their removal too. Indeed, I alone am to be known from all the Vedas. I bring about the fruition of the Vedic rituals; I alone am the knower of the Vedas.

title: There are two kinds of persons spoken of in the sastra: the perishabl…
sanskrit: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते
transliteration: dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha |\nkṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate |
meaning: There are two kinds of persons spoken of in the sastra: the perishable (ksara) and the imperishable (aksara). All beings are perishable, while the imperishable is called the unchanging (kutastha).

title: There is a Supreme Person other than these
sanskrit: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः
transliteration: uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ |\nyo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ |
meaning: There is a Supreme Person other than these. He is referred to as the Supreme Self (Paramatma) in all the Vedas. He, as the Immutable One and the Lord, enters the threefold world and supports it.

title: Because I transcend the perishable person and am also higher than the…
sanskrit: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
transliteration: yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ |\nato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ |
meaning: Because I transcend the perishable person and am also higher than the imperishable one, therefore I am referred to in the Smrti and the Veda as the Supreme Person (Purusotama).

title: He who, without delusion, thus knows Me as the Supreme Self, knows al…
sanskrit: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत
transliteration: yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam |\nsa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata |
meaning: He who, without delusion, thus knows Me as the Supreme Self, knows all, O Arjuna, and worships Me in every way.

title: Thus, O sinless one, this most mysterious doctrine has been imparted…
sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत
transliteration: iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha |\netad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata |
meaning: Thus, O sinless one, this most mysterious doctrine has been imparted by Me. By understanding this, one will become truly wise and fulfill their duty.

title: The Lord said, "Fearlessness, purity of mind, devotion to meditation…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nअभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।\nदानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nabhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ |\ndānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam |
meaning: The Lord said, "Fearlessness, purity of mind, devotion to meditation on the knowledge of the self, alms-giving, self-control, worship, study of the Vedas, austerity, and uprightness—

title: Non-injury, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquility, non…
sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्
transliteration: ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam |\ndayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam |
meaning: Non-injury, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquility, non-slandering of others, compassion for all beings, freedom from desire, gentleness, a sense of shame, and freedom from fickleness;

title: Grandeur, patience, fortitude, purity, freedom from hatred and over-p…
sanskrit: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।\nभवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत
transliteration: tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā |\nbhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata |
meaning: Grandeur, patience, fortitude, purity, freedom from hatred and over-pride—these, O Arjuna, belong to one who is born to a divine destiny.

title: Pompousness, arrogance, self-conceit, wrath, rudeness, and ignorance—…
sanskrit: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्
transliteration: dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha |\najñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm |
meaning: Pompousness, arrogance, self-conceit, wrath, rudeness, and ignorance—these, O Arjuna, belong to one who is born with a demonic destiny.

title: The divine destiny is said to lead to liberation, while the demoniac…
sanskrit: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव
transliteration: daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā |\nmā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava |
meaning: The divine destiny is said to lead to liberation, while the demoniac to bondage. Do not grieve, O Arjuna, for you are born with a divine destiny.

title: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniac
sanskrit: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु
transliteration: dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha |\ndaivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu |
meaning: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniac. The divine have been described at length. Hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniac.

title: The demoniacal men neither know action nor renunciation
sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
transliteration: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ |\nna śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate |
meaning: The demoniacal men neither know action nor renunciation. They have no cleanliness, nor right conduct, nor truth.

title: They maintain: 'The universe is without truth, with no foundation, an…
sanskrit: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्
transliteration: asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram |\naparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam |
meaning: They maintain: 'The universe is without truth, with no foundation, and without a Lord (Isvara). What else could exist without mutual causation? It has lust as its cause.'

title: Holding this view, these men of lost souls and feeble understanding d…
sanskrit: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः
transliteration: etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ |\nprabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ |
meaning: Holding this view, these men of lost souls and feeble understanding do cruel deeds, leading to the destruction of the world.

title: Turning to insatiable desires, seizing through delusion unjustly acqu…
sanskrit: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः
transliteration: kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ |\nmohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ |
meaning: Turning to insatiable desires, seizing through delusion unjustly acquired wealth, and following impious vows, they act, full of ostentation, pride, and arrogance.

title: Obsessed by unlimited cares that end with dissolution, looking upon t…
sanskrit: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः
transliteration: chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ |\nkāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ |
meaning: Obsessed by unlimited cares that end with dissolution, looking upon the enjoyment of desires as their highest aim, and convinced that this is all;

title: Bound by hundreds of fetters of hopes, given over to desire and anger…
sanskrit: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्
transliteration: āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ |\nīhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān |
meaning: Bound by hundreds of fetters of hopes, given over to desire and anger, they strive unjustly to gather wealth for the gratification of their desires.

title: 'This I have gained today, and this desire I shall attain
sanskrit: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्
transliteration: idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham |\nidam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam |
meaning: 'This I have gained today, and this desire I shall attain. This wealth is mine, and this will also be mine hereafter.

title: 'I have slain this enemy, and I shall slay others too
sanskrit: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी
transliteration: asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api |\nīśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī |
meaning: 'I have slain this enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord, the enjoyer, the successful one, the strong one, and the happy one.'

title: 'I am wealthy and high-born; who else is equal to me
sanskrit: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः
transliteration:
āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā |
yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ |
aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ |
prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau |
meaning: 'I am wealthy and high-born; who else is equal to me? I shall sacrifice, I shall give alms, I shall rejoice.' Thus they think, deluded by ignorance.

title: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, ensnared in the net of delusion, add…
sanskrit: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ
transliteration: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau |
meaning: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, ensnared in the net of delusion, addicted to sensual pleasures, they fall into a wretched Naraka.

title: Self-conceited, self-sufficient, intoxicated by wealth and pride, the…
sanskrit: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्
transliteration: ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ |\nyajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam |
meaning: Self-conceited, self-sufficient, intoxicated by wealth and pride, they perform sacrifices in name only, ostentatiously and not according to the injunctions of the scriptures.

title: Depending on their egoism, power, and pride, as well as their desires…
sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः
transliteration: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ |\nmām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ |
meaning: Depending on their egoism, power, and pride, as well as their desires and wrath, these malicious men hate Me in their own bodies and in those of others.

title: Those who are hateful, cruel, the vilest and most inauspicious of man…
sanskrit: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु
transliteration: tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān |\nkṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu |
meaning: Those who are hateful, cruel, the vilest and most inauspicious of mankind, I hurl forever into the cycles of births and deaths, into the wombs of demons.

title: Fallen into demoniac wombs in birth after birth, these deluded men, n…
sanskrit: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
transliteration: āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani |\nmām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim |
meaning: Fallen into demoniac wombs in birth after birth, these deluded men, not attaining Me, further sink down to the lowest level, O Arjuna.

title: Desire, wrath, and greed—these are the three gateways to Naraka, ruin…
sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
transliteration: tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ |\nkāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet |
meaning: Desire, wrath, and greed—these are the three gateways to Naraka, ruinous to the self. Therefore, one should abandon these three.

title: One who has been released from these three gates of darkness, O Arjun…
sanskrit: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
transliteration: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ |\nācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim |
meaning: One who has been released from these three gates of darkness, O Arjuna, works for the benefit of the self; thus, they reach the supreme state.

title: He who, abandoning the injunctions of the Sastras, acts under the inf…
sanskrit: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
transliteration: yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ |\nna sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim |
meaning: He who, abandoning the injunctions of the Sastras, acts under the influence of desire, attains neither perfection nor pleasure, nor the supreme state.

title: Therefore, let the Sastra be your authority for determining what shou…
sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि
transliteration: tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau |\njñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi |
meaning: Therefore, let the Sastra be your authority for determining what should be done and what should not be done. Knowing what is enjoined in the injunctions of the Sastra, you should perform work here.

title: Arjuna said, "Now, O Krsna, what is the position or basis of those wh…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ |\nteṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ |
meaning: Arjuna said, "Now, O Krsna, what is the position or basis of those who, despite leaving aside the injunction of the Sastra, still worship with faith? Is it Sattva, Rajas, or Tamas?"

title: The Lord said, "The faith of embodied beings is threefold, born of th…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\ntri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā |\nsāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu |
meaning: The Lord said, "The faith of embodied beings is threefold, born of their own nature and constituted of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas. Now, listen to me about it."

title: O Arjuna, the faith of everyone is in accordance with their inner org…
sanskrit: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः
transliteration: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata |\nśhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ |
meaning: O Arjuna, the faith of everyone is in accordance with their inner organ (Antahkarana). Each person consists of faith; whatever their faith is, that is who they are.

title: The sattvic types worship the gods; the rajasic types worship yaksas…
sanskrit: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः
transliteration: yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ |\npretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ |
meaning: The sattvic types worship the gods; the rajasic types worship yaksas and rakshasas; and the others, the tamasic types, worship the departed ancestors and hosts of bhutas.

title: Those men who practice terrible austerities not enjoined by the scrip…
sanskrit: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः
transliteration: aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ |\ndambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ |
meaning: Those men who practice terrible austerities not enjoined by the scriptures, given to ostentation and conceit, and prompted by the force of sensual desires and passions;

title: These foolish men, who torture the group of elements in their bodies…
sanskrit: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्
transliteration: karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ |\nmāṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān |
meaning: These foolish men, who torture the group of elements in their bodies and Me, who dwell within the body—know them to be demoniacal in their resolves.

title: Even the food that is dear to all is threefold; so too are sacrifices…
sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
transliteration: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ |\nyajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu |
meaning: Even the food that is dear to all is threefold; so too are sacrifices, austerities, and gifts. Listen to this distinction among them.

title: Foods that promote longevity, intellectual alertness, strength, healt…
sanskrit: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
transliteration: āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ |\nrasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ |
meaning: Foods that promote longevity, intellectual alertness, strength, health, pleasure, and happiness, and those that are sweet, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to sattvic men.

title: Foods that are bitter, sour, very salty, excessively heating, highly…
sanskrit: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः
transliteration: kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣhṇa- tīkṣhṇa-rūkṣha-vidāhinaḥ |\nāhārā rājasasyeṣhṭā duḥkha-śhokāmaya-pradāḥ |
meaning: Foods that are bitter, sour, very salty, excessively heating, highly pungent, dry, and burning are all dear to Rajasika men; they cause pain, sorrow, and disease.

title: That food which is stale, tasteless, putrid, decayed, rejected, uncle…
sanskrit: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्
transliteration: yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat |\nuchchhiṣhṭam api chāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam |
meaning: That food which is stale, tasteless, putrid, decayed, rejected, unclean, is dear to those of a Tamasic nature.

title: The sacrifice (worship) marked by Sattva is what is offered by those…
sanskrit: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः
transliteration: aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yajño vidhi-driṣhṭo ya ijyate |\nyaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ |
meaning: The sacrifice (worship) marked by Sattva is what is offered by those who desire no fruit and have the conviction that it should be performed as prescribed in the scriptures.

title: But that sacrifice which is offered with the intention of gaining a r…
sanskrit: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
transliteration: abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat |\nijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam |
meaning: But that sacrifice which is offered with the intention of gaining a reward and for the sake of show, know it, O Arjuna, to be Rajasic.

title: That sacrifice which is devoid of authority, which uses offerings not…
sanskrit: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते
transliteration: vidhi-hīnam asṛiṣhṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣhiṇam |\nśhraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ parichakṣhate |
meaning: That sacrifice which is devoid of authority, which uses offerings not sanctioned by the Sastras, which is performed without recitation of hymns and devoid of gifts and faith - that, they say, is marked by Tamas.

title: Worshiping the gods, the twice-born, the preceptors, the enlightened…
sanskrit: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते
transliteration: deva-dwija-guru-prājña- pūjanaṁ śhaucham ārjavam |\nbrahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate |
meaning: Worshiping the gods, the twice-born, the preceptors, the enlightened ones, practicing purity, uprightness, continence, and non-injury—these are called austerity of the body.

title: Speech that causes no shock, is true, pleasant, and beneficial, and a…
sanskrit: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते
transliteration: anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat |\nsvādhyāyābhyasanaṁ chaiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa uchyate |
meaning: Speech that causes no shock, is true, pleasant, and beneficial, and also the practice of reciting scriptures, is called the austerity of speech.

title: Serenity of mind, benevolence, silence, self-control, and purity of m…
sanskrit: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते
transliteration: manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ |\nbhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate |
meaning: Serenity of mind, benevolence, silence, self-control, and purity of mind—these are known as austerity of the mind.

title: The threefold austerity, practiced with supreme faith by men who desi…
sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ित्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते
transliteration: śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ |\naphalākāṅkṣhibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ parichakṣhate |
meaning: The threefold austerity, practiced with supreme faith by men who desire no fruit and are devoted—they call it austerity of Sattva.

title: That austerity, practiced with ostentation for the sake of gaining re…
sanskrit: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्
transliteration: satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena chaiva yat |\nkriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam |
meaning: That austerity, practiced with ostentation for the sake of gaining respect, praise, and reverence, is here said to be Rajasa. It is unsteady and impermanent.

title: That austerity which is practised from deluded notions by means of se…
sanskrit: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ |\nparasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛitam |
meaning: That austerity which is practised from deluded notions by means of self-torture or to injure another is said to be Tamasika.

title: Gifts given with the feeling that it is one's own duty to give, to on…
sanskrit: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
transliteration: dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe |\ndeśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam |
meaning: Gifts given with the feeling that it is one's own duty to give, to one who makes no return, at the proper place and time to the deserving person—that is said to be sattvika.

title: But that which is given as a consideration for something received or…
sanskrit: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
transliteration: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ |\ndīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam |
meaning: But that which is given as a consideration for something received or in expectation of a future reward, or grudgingly, is called a Rajasika gift.

title: That gift which is given at the wrong place, wrong time, to an unwort…
sanskrit: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate |\nasat-kṛitam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam |
meaning: That gift which is given at the wrong place, wrong time, to an unworthy recipient, without due respect and with contempt, is called the gift of a Tamasa nature.

title: Om, Tat, Sat—thus, Brahman is denoted by this threefold expression
sanskrit: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
transliteration: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ |\nbrāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā |
meaning: Om, Tat, Sat—thus, Brahman is denoted by this threefold expression. In the past, Brahmanas, the Vedas, and sacrifices were ordained in association with these.

title: Therefore, the Veda-enjoined sacrificial acts, gifts, and austerities…
sanskrit: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
transliteration: tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ |\npravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām |
meaning: Therefore, the Veda-enjoined sacrificial acts, gifts, and austerities, expounded by the Vedas, or those belonging to the first three stations, are always begun after pronouncing Om at the beginning.

title: Acts of sacrifice, austerity, and various gifts are performed without…
sanskrit: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि
transliteration: tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ |\ndāna-kriyāśh cha vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣha-kāṅkṣhibhiḥ |
meaning: Acts of sacrifice, austerity, and various gifts are performed without aiming at a reward by those who seek release, after pronouncing Tat.

title: This term "Sat" is used in the sense of existence and goodness
sanskrit: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
transliteration: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate |\npraśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate |
meaning: This term "Sat" is used in the sense of existence and goodness. And so also, O Arjuna, the word "Sat" is applied to an auspicious action.

title: Devotion to sacrifice, austerity, and gifts is also referred to as Sa…
sanskrit: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते
transliteration: yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate |\nkarma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate |
meaning: Devotion to sacrifice, austerity, and gifts is also referred to as Sat; and thus, any action for such purposes is known as Sat.

title: Whatever offering or gift is made, whatever austerity is practiced, a…
sanskrit: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
transliteration: aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat |\nasad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha |
meaning: Whatever offering or gift is made, whatever austerity is practiced, and whatever action is performed without faith, that is called Asat, O Arjuna. It is of no value here or hereafter.

title: Arjuna said, "I desire to know the truth about renunciation and abneg…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच\nसंन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्।\nत्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nsannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum |\ntyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana |
meaning: Arjuna said, "I desire to know the truth about renunciation and abnegation separately, O Krishna."

title: The Lord said, "The sages hold that Sannyasa is the giving up of all…
sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाच\nकाम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।\nसर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः
transliteration: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha |\nkāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ |\nsarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vichakṣhaṇāḥ |
meaning: The Lord said, "The sages hold that Sannyasa is the giving up of all works motivated by desire, and the wise declare Tyaga to be the abandonment of the fruits of all works.

title: Some sages say that all actions should be abandoned as evil; others d…
sanskrit: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।\nयज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे
transliteration: tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ |\nyajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti chāpare |
meaning: Some sages say that all actions should be abandoned as evil; others declare that works such as sacrifices, gifts, and austerities should not be abandoned.

title: Listen to My decision, O Arjuna, concerning abandonment; for abandonm…
sanskrit: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
transliteration: niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama |\ntyāgo hi puruṣha-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ |
meaning: Listen to My decision, O Arjuna, concerning abandonment; for abandonment is declared to be of three kinds.

title: (a) The acts of sacrifice, gifts, and austerities should not be relin…
sanskrit: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्
transliteration: yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat |\nyajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām |
meaning: (a) The acts of sacrifice, gifts, and austerities should not be relinquished; but should be performed... (b) ...For sacrifices, gifts, and austerities are the means of purification for the wise.

title: It is My decided and final view that even these acts should be done,…
sanskrit: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्िचतं मतमुत्तमम्
transliteration: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha |\nkartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam |
meaning: It is My decided and final view that even these acts should be done, O Arjuna, with relinquishment of attachment and the forsaking of the fruits thereof.

title: But the renunciation of obligatory acts is not proper; abandonment of…
sanskrit: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः
transliteration: niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate |\nmohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
meaning: But the renunciation of obligatory acts is not proper; abandonment of these through delusion is declared to be of a Tamasic nature.

title: He who renounces acts that are painful out of fear of bodily sufferin…
sanskrit: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
transliteration: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet |\nsa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet |
meaning: He who renounces acts that are painful out of fear of bodily suffering performs a Rajasika abandonment; however, he does not gain the fruit of such abandonment.

title: When actions are performed as they ought to be done, O Arjuna, renoun…
sanskrit: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन।सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
transliteration: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna |\nsaṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ chaiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ |
meaning: When actions are performed as they ought to be done, O Arjuna, renouncing attachment and the results thereof, such abandonment is regarded as Sattvika.

title: One who has abandoned, imbued with Sattva, wise, and whose doubts hav…
sanskrit: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः
transliteration: na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate |\ntyāgī sattva-samāviṣhṭo medhāvī chhinna-sanśhayaḥ |
meaning: One who has abandoned, imbued with Sattva, wise, and whose doubts have been dispelled—such a person neither hates disagreeable acts nor clings to agreeable ones.

title: For, it is impossible for one who has a body to completely abandon ac…
sanskrit: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते
transliteration: na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ |\nyas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate |
meaning: For, it is impossible for one who has a body to completely abandon actions. But he who gives up the results of his works is called the one who has abandoned them.

title: Undesirable, desirable, and mixed—thus, threefold is the fruit of wor…
sanskrit: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
transliteration: aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam |\nbhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit |
meaning: Undesirable, desirable, and mixed—thus, threefold is the fruit of work that accrues after death to those who have not renounced; but to those who have renounced, none accrues whatsoever.

title: Learn from Me, O Arjuna, these five causes for the accomplishment of…
sanskrit: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्
transliteration: pañchaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me |\nsānkhye kṛitānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām |
meaning: Learn from Me, O Arjuna, these five causes for the accomplishment of all acts, as described in Sankhya-krtanta—the science of exact understanding of things—for the accomplishment of works.

title: The seat of action, the agent, the various kinds of organs, the diffe…
sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्
transliteration: adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham |\nvividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam |
meaning: The seat of action, the agent, the various kinds of organs, the different and distinctive functions of vital air, and the fifth among these—Divinity—all these.

title: For whatever action a person undertakes with their body, speech, and…
sanskrit: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
transliteration: śharīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ |\nnyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ |
meaning: For whatever action a person undertakes with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, i.e., enjoined or forbidden by the Sastras, the following five are its causes:

title: Therefore, he who, due to his uncultivated understanding, perceives o…
sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः
transliteration: tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ |\npaśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ |
meaning: Therefore, he who, due to his uncultivated understanding, perceives only the self as the agent, he of wicked mind does not truly perceive.

title: He who is free from the notion of 'I am the doer,' and whose understa…
sanskrit: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
transliteration: yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate |\nhatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate |
meaning: He who is free from the notion of 'I am the doer,' and whose understanding is not tainted, does not slay, even though he slays all these men, nor is he bound.

title: Knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the knower are the threefold…
sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः
transliteration: jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā |\nkaraṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ |
meaning: Knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the knower are the threefold incitements to action. The instrument, the act, and the agent are the threefold constituents of action.

title: Knowledge, action, and agent are declared in the science of the Gunas…
sanskrit: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि
transliteration: jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ |\nprochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api |
meaning: Knowledge, action, and agent are declared in the science of the Gunas to be of three kinds, according to the difference in the Gunas. Listen to them also as they are.

title: Know that knowledge to be sattvika, by which one sees in all beings a…
sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्
transliteration: sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate |\navibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam |
meaning: Know that knowledge to be sattvika, by which one sees in all beings an immutable existence, undivided even in the divided.

title: But that knowledge which sees all beings, due to their individual nat…
sanskrit: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
transliteration: pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān |\nvetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam |
meaning: But that knowledge which sees all beings, due to their individual nature, as distinct entities—know that knowledge to be Rajasic.

title: But that knowledge is declared to be Tamasika which clings to one sin…
sanskrit: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam |\natattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam |
meaning: But that knowledge is declared to be Tamasika which clings to one single act as if it were the whole, which is not based on reason, and which is false and insignificant.

title: That obligatory act is said to be Sattvika, which is done without att…
sanskrit: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते
transliteration: niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam |\naphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate |
meaning: That obligatory act is said to be Sattvika, which is done without attachment, without desire or aversion, and by one who seeks no fruit.

title: But that act is said to be Rajasic, which is performed with great eff…
sanskrit: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ |\nkriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam |
meaning: But that act is said to be Rajasic, which is performed with great effort by one who seeks to gratify their desires and under the prompting of egoism.

title: That act is said to be Tamasika which is undertaken through delusion,…
sanskrit: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते
transliteration: anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham |\nmohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate |
meaning: That act is said to be Tamasika which is undertaken through delusion, without regard to consequences, loss, injury, and one's own capacity.

title: That agent is said to be Sattvika, who is free from attachment, who d…
sanskrit: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते
transliteration: mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ |\nsiddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate |
meaning: That agent is said to be Sattvika, who is free from attachment, who does not boast of himself, who is endowed with steadiness and zeal, and who is unaffected by success and failure.

title: That doer is called Rajasika who is passionate, who seeks the fruits…
sanskrit: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः
transliteration: rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsātmako ‘śhuchiḥ |\nharṣha-śhokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
meaning: That doer is called Rajasika who is passionate, who seeks the fruits of his actions, who is greedy, harmful, and impure, and who is swayed by delight and grief.

title: That doer is said to be Tamasika who is unqualified, unrefined, obsti…
sanskrit: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते
transliteration: ayuktaḥ prākṛitaḥ stabdhaḥ śhaṭho naiṣhkṛitiko ‘lasaḥ |\nviṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate |
meaning: That doer is said to be Tamasika who is unqualified, unrefined, obstinate, depraved, dishonest, indolent, despondent, and lethargic.

title: Hear now, O Arjuna, the threefold division of Buddhi (reason) and Dhr…
sanskrit: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय
transliteration: buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu |\nprochyamānam aśheṣheṇa pṛithaktvena dhanañjaya |
meaning: Hear now, O Arjuna, the threefold division of Buddhi (reason) and Dhrti (fortitude) according to the Gunas, to be fully and severally set forth.

title: That Buddhi, O Arjuna, which knows activity and renunciation, what sh…
sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
transliteration: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye |\nbandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī |
meaning: That Buddhi, O Arjuna, which knows activity and renunciation, what should be done and what should not be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and release—that Buddhi is Sattvika.

title: The Buddhi that gives an erroneous knowledge of Dharma and Adharma (i…
sanskrit: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी
transliteration: yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha |\nayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī |
meaning: The Buddhi that gives an erroneous knowledge of Dharma and Adharma (its opposite) and also of what should be done and what should not be done, O Arjuna, is Rajasic.

title: That Buddhi, O Arjuna, which, enveloped in darkness, regards Adharma…
sanskrit: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी
transliteration: adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā |\nsarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī |
meaning: That Buddhi, O Arjuna, which, enveloped in darkness, regards Adharma as Dharma and reverses every value, is Tamasika.

title: That fortitude, by which one maintains the unwavering activities of t…
sanskrit: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
transliteration: dhṛityā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ |\nyogenāvyabhichāriṇyā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī |
meaning: That fortitude, by which one maintains the unwavering activities of the mind and vital force, and these sense-organs, through yoga—that fortitude is of the nature of sattva.

title: That dhṛti, O Arjuna, by which one, who is desirous of fruits, longs…
sanskrit: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी
transliteration: yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛityā dhārayate ‘rjuna |\nprasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī |
meaning: That dhṛti, O Arjuna, by which one, who is desirous of fruits, longs for them with intense attachment and holds fast to duty, desire, and wealth—that dhṛti is rajasika.

title: That Dhrti, by which a foolish person does not give up sleep, fear, g…
sanskrit: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च।न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी
transliteration: yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha |\nna vimuñchati durmedhā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī |
meaning: That Dhrti, by which a foolish person does not give up sleep, fear, grief, depression, and passion, O Arjuna, is of the nature of Tamas.

title: Now hear from Me, O Arjuna, the threefold division of pleasure৷৷ that…
sanskrit: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ।अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति
transliteration:
sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha |
abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ cha nigachchhati |
yat tad agre viṣham iva pariṇāme ‘mṛitopamam |
tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam |
meaning: Now hear from Me, O Arjuna, the threefold division of pleasure৷৷ that in which one rejoices through long practice and in which one comes to the end of pain.

title: That which, at first, is like a poison but becomes like an elixir in…
sanskrit: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्।तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्
transliteration: yat  tad agre    viṣam   iva pariṇāme    'mṛtopamam  tat sukhaṁ  sāttvikaṁ   proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam |
meaning: That which, at first, is like a poison but becomes like an elixir in the end, born from the serene state of mind focused on the Self—such pleasure is said to be Sattvika.

title: That pleasure which arises from the contact of senses with their obje…
sanskrit: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्
transliteration: viṣhayendriya-sanyogād yat tad agre ’mṛitopamam |\npariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam |
meaning: That pleasure which arises from the contact of senses with their objects, which is like elixir at first but like poison in the end, is said to be Rajasic.

title: That pleasure which, at the beginning and end, deludes the self, thro…
sanskrit: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ |\nnidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam |
meaning: That pleasure which, at the beginning and end, deludes the self, through sleep, sloth, and error, is declared to be tamasic.

title: There is no creature, on earth or among the gods in heaven, that is e…
sanskrit: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः
transliteration: na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ |\nsattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ |
meaning: There is no creature, on earth or among the gods in heaven, that is exempt from these three Gunas born of Prakrti.

title: The duties of the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras are clear…
sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः
transliteration: brāhmaṇa-kṣhatriya-viśhāṁ śhūdrāṇāṁ cha parantapa |\nkarmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ |
meaning: The duties of the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras are clearly divided, O Arjuna, according to their Gunas, born of their nature.

title: The control of the senses and mind, austerity, purity, forbearance, u…
sanskrit: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्
transliteration: śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha |\njñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam |
meaning: The control of the senses and mind, austerity, purity, forbearance, uprightness, knowledge, special knowledge, and faith—all these constitute the duty of a Brahmana, born of his inherent nature.

title: Valor, invincibility, steadiness, dexterity, and not fleeing in battl…
sanskrit: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्
transliteration: śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam |\ndānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam |
meaning: Valor, invincibility, steadiness, dexterity, and not fleeing in battle, generosity, and regality are the duties of a Kshatriya, born of his inherent nature.

title: Agriculture, cattle-breeding, and trade are the duties of the Vaisya,…
sanskrit: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्
transliteration: kṛiṣhi-gau-rakṣhya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśhya-karma svabhāva-jam |\nparicharyātmakaṁ karma śhūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam |
meaning: Agriculture, cattle-breeding, and trade are the duties of the Vaisya, born of their nature. And the duty of a Sudra is one of service, born of their nature.

title: Devoting oneself to one's duty, one attains perfection
sanskrit: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु
transliteration: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ |\nsva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu |
meaning: Devoting oneself to one's duty, one attains perfection. Hear now how one devoted to their own duty attains perfection.

title: From whom all beings arise and by whom all this is pervaded—by worshi…
sanskrit: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः
transliteration: yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam |\nsva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ |
meaning: From whom all beings arise and by whom all this is pervaded—by worshipping Him with one's own duty, one reaches perfection.

title: Better is one's own duty, though ill done, than the duty of another,…
sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
transliteration: śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt |\nsvabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham |
meaning: Better is one's own duty, though ill done, than the duty of another, though well-performed. When one does the duty ordained by their own nature, they incur no stain.

title: One should not relinquish one's work, O Arjuna, though it may be impe…
sanskrit: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः
transliteration: saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet |\nsarvārambhā hi doṣheṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛitāḥ |
meaning: One should not relinquish one's work, O Arjuna, though it may be imperfect; for, all endeavors are enveloped by imperfections as fire is by smoke.

title: He whose understanding is unattached on all sides, whose self is cont…
sanskrit: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति
transliteration: asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛihaḥ |\nnaiṣhkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigachchhati |
meaning: He whose understanding is unattached on all sides, whose self is controlled, who is free from desires—he attains the supreme perfection transcending all activity through renunciation.

title: Learn from me, O Arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection…
sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा
transliteration: siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |\nsamāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā |
meaning: Learn from me, O Arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection attains the Brahman—the supreme consummation of knowledge.

title: Endowed with a purified understanding, subduing the mind with steadin…
sanskrit: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च
transliteration: buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha |\nśhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha |
meaning: Endowed with a purified understanding, subduing the mind with steadiness, relinquishing sound and other objects of the senses and casting aside love and hate;

title: Resorting to solitude, eating sparingly, restraining speech, body, an…
sanskrit: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः
transliteration: vivikta-sevī laghv-āśhī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ |\ndhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśhritaḥ |
meaning: Resorting to solitude, eating sparingly, restraining speech, body, and mind, ever engaged in the yoga of meditation and taking refuge in dispassion;

title: Forsaking egoism, power, pride, desire, wrath, and possessions, with…
sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
transliteration: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham |\nvimuchya nirmamaḥ śhānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate |
meaning: Forsaking egoism, power, pride, desire, wrath, and possessions, with no feeling of 'mine' and tranquil, he becomes worthy of the state of Brahman.

title: Having realized the state of Brahman, tranquil, he neither grieves no…
sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्
transliteration: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati |\nsamaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām |
meaning: Having realized the state of Brahman, tranquil, he neither grieves nor craves. Regarding all beings alike, he attains supreme devotion to Me.

title: Through devotion, he comes to know Me fully—who and what I am in real…
sanskrit: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्
transliteration: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ |\ntato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram |
meaning: Through devotion, he comes to know Me fully—who and what I am in reality, who I am and how I am. Knowing Me thus in truth, he forthwith enters into Me.

title: Taking refuge in Me and performing all works constantly, one, by My g…
sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्
transliteration: sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśhrayaḥ |\nmat-prasādād avāpnoti śhāśhvataṁ padam avyayam |
meaning: Taking refuge in Me and performing all works constantly, one, by My grace, attains the eternal and immutable abode.

title: Surrender all your actions to Me with your mind, keep Me as your goal…
sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव
transliteration: chetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ |\nbuddhi-yogam upāśhritya mach-chittaḥ satataṁ bhava |
meaning: Surrender all your actions to Me with your mind, keep Me as your goal, and practice Buddhi-yoga, focusing your thoughts on Me always.

title: Focusing your thoughts on Me, you shall, by My grace, cross over all…
sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि
transliteration: mach-chittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣhyasi |\natha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi |
meaning: Focusing your thoughts on Me, you shall, by My grace, cross over all difficulties. If, however, out of self-conceit, you do not heed Me, you will perish.

title: If, in your self-conceit, you think, 'I will not fight,' your resolve…
sanskrit: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति
transliteration: yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase |\nmithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati |
meaning: If, in your self-conceit, you think, 'I will not fight,' your resolve is futile. Nature will compel you.

title: O Arjuna, bound by your own duty born out of your own inner dispositi…
sanskrit: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्
transliteration: swbhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā |\nkartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat |
meaning: O Arjuna, bound by your own duty born out of your own inner disposition, and having no control over your own will, you will be compelled to do that very thing which you now do not desire to do through delusion.

title: The Lord, O Arjuna, abides in the heart of every being, spinning them…
sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया
transliteration: īśhvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛid-deśhe ‘rjuna tiṣhṭhati |\nbhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā |
meaning: The Lord, O Arjuna, abides in the heart of every being, spinning them round and round, as if mounted on a wheel, by His power.

title: Seek refuge in Him alone, O Arjuna, with the entirety of your being
sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्
transliteration: tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata |\ntat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam |
meaning: Seek refuge in Him alone, O Arjuna, with the entirety of your being. By His grace, you shall find supreme peace and an eternal abode.

title: Thus, the knowledge, the mystery of mysteries, has been declared to y…
sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
transliteration: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā |\nvimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru |
meaning: Thus, the knowledge, the mystery of mysteries, has been declared to you by Me. Reflecting on it fully, do as you will.

title: Hear again My supreme word, the most secret of all; as I am exceeding…
sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
transliteration: sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ |\niṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam |
meaning: Hear again My supreme word, the most secret of all; as I am exceedingly fond of you, I am telling you what is good for you.

title: Focus your mind on Me
sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
transliteration: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru |\nmām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me |
meaning: Focus your mind on Me. Be My devotee. Worship Me. Prostrate before Me. You will come to Me alone. I promise you truly; for you are dear to Me.

title: Relinquishing all Dharmas completely, seek Me alone for refuge
sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
transliteration: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja |\nahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ |
meaning: Relinquishing all Dharmas completely, seek Me alone for refuge. I will release you from all sins; grieve not.

title: Never should this be told by you to one who is not austere, who is no…
sanskrit: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति
transliteration: idaṁ te nātapaskyāya nābhaktāya kadāchana |\nna chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi |
meaning: Never should this be told by you to one who is not austere, who is not a devotee, nor to one who has no desire to listen, nor certainly to him who speaks ill of Me.

title: He who proclaims this supreme mystery among My devotees shall come to…
sanskrit: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः
transliteration: ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati |\nbhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ |
meaning: He who proclaims this supreme mystery among My devotees shall come to Me, acquiring supreme devotion towards Me. There is no doubt about this.

title: There is no one among men who does dearer service to Me than him
sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि
transliteration: na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ |\nbhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi |
meaning: There is no one among men who does dearer service to Me than him. Nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to Me than him.

title: And he who will study our dialogue, which is consistent with Dharma,…
sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः
transliteration: adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ |\njñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ |
meaning: And he who will study our dialogue, which is consistent with Dharma, by him I shall be worshipped through the sacrifice of knowledge; that is My view.

title: And the man who listens to it with faith and without cavil, he too sh…
sanskrit: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्
transliteration: śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ |\nso ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām |
meaning: And the man who listens to it with faith and without cavil, he too shall be released and shall reach the auspicious realms of those who have performed virtuous deeds.

title: Have you heard this, O Arjuna, with a single-minded focus
sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय
transliteration: kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā |\nkachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya |
meaning: Have you heard this, O Arjuna, with a single-minded focus? Has your delusion, caused by ignorance, been dispelled?

title: Arjuna said, "My delusion has been destroyed, and, by Your grace, O K…
sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव
transliteration: arjuna uvācha |\nnaṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta |\nsthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava |
meaning: Arjuna said, "My delusion has been destroyed, and, by Your grace, O Krsna, I have gained knowledge (Smrti). Freed from doubts, I stand steadfast, and I will fulfill Your will."

title: Sanjaya said, Thus I have heard this wondrous dialogue between Vasude…
sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्
transliteration: sañjaya uvācha |\nity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ |\nsaṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam |
meaning: Sanjaya said, Thus I have heard this wondrous dialogue between Vasudeva and the great-minded Arjuna, which makes my hair stand on end.

title: By the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme mystery of Yoga, dec…
sanskrit: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्
transliteration: vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param |\nyogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam |
meaning: By the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme mystery of Yoga, declared in person by Krsna, the Lord of Yoga.

title: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous and auspicious dial…
sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः
transliteration: rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam |\nkeśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ |
meaning: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous and auspicious dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice time and again.

title: And, remembering over and over again that most marvelous form of Hari…
sanskrit: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः।\nविस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः
transliteration: tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ |\nvismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ |
meaning: And, remembering over and over again that most marvelous form of Hari, great is my amazement, O King, and I rejoice again and again.

title: Wherever there is Sri Krsna, the Lord of Yoga, and Arjuna the archer,…
sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।\nतत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम
transliteration: yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |\ntatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama |
meaning: Wherever there is Sri Krsna, the Lord of Yoga, and Arjuna the archer, there is always fortune, victory, wealth, and sound morality. This is my firm conviction.
